Compensation Range: €65K - €100K

title: Senior Manager Brand Strategy & Creative Solutions (m/f/d) Barcelona
Senior Art Director (Beauty, Skincare, Wellness & Lifestyle)
Creative Lead (Social & UGC)
description:
**Who we are**
==============

Creative Milkshake is a remote-first performance creative agency. We make scroll-stopping short-form ads for some of the world’s most exciting DTC brands on Meta and TikTok - high-volume, fast-moving, and built to convert.

We’re a close-knit team of ~34 people spread across the Netherlands, the Philippines, South Africa, Spain, and beyond. We’ve recently joined the Fieldtrip group alongside inBeat, which means we’re growing - in ambition, in capability, and in the complexity of clients we work with.

Our Amsterdam studio is the creative heart of our production operation. Over the next 1–2 years, we’re expanding from UGC-first content toward elevated branded formats, this role is central to holding the quality bar as we scale.

**The role**
============

We make a lot of content. Across a portfolio of DTC clients, our studio shoots and edits dozens of UGC ads every week. Most of it is good. Some of it is great. And the difference between good and great is specific: the hook that actually stops the scroll, the edit that holds attention, the subtle thing that makes a piece of content feel native rather than forced. That's what this role is about.

We’re looking for a Creative Lead (Social & UGC) to be the final creative eye before work reaches clients. You'll review raw footage, storyboards, and final edits, and give the kind of specific, hands-on feedback that actually improves the work rather than just flags problems.

You’ve made content yourself. You’ve been on set, you’ve been in the edit, you know what it takes to make a 15-second video that does something to the person watching it. You bring that maker's instinct to a quality and creative leadership role, and you use it to raise the bar across a whole studio.

**Timezone preference**
=======================

For this role, we're only considering candidates based in +/ 3 hrs CET time zone.

**What you’ll do**
==================

**Hold the creative quality bar**
---------------------------------

* Review storyboards, raw footage when necessary, and final edits before they go to clients
* Be the quality gate: if something isn’t ready, you say so clearly, and you explain exactly what needs to change and why
* Build and maintain the ad example library, creative checklists, and “what good looks like” guides that codify your instinct into something the whole team can learn from
* Spot recurring patterns: editing habits that aren't working, storyboard mistakes that keep appearing, hooks that aren't landing. Address them at the root, not ad by ad

**Give hands-on creative direction in post**
--------------------------------------------

* Review raw footage after shoots and provide clear direction on what’s usable, what’s not, and what to do differently next time
* Give precise editing feedback to our video editors: pacing, cut points, text overlays, sound design, the craft layer that turns a decent edit into something that performs
* Understand design fundamentals well enough to give direction on static assets, thumbnail frames, and text treatments: what reads on a phone screen and what doesn't
* Know what a 9:16 UGC ad needs to do in the first 2 seconds, and be able to articulate it in a way an editor can act on immediately

**Support production with a creative eye**
------------------------------------------

* Review storyboards before shoots and flag what isn’t shootable as written, what talent or set requirements are missing, and where the brief and the concept have drifted
* Give production the creative context they need to go into a shoot prepared: what angles matter, what the edit is going to need, what “good” looks like for this format and this brand
* Periodically join shoots at the Amsterdam studio (+-3 times a year) when creative stakes are high or a new format is being tested
* Over time, help build a visual reference library for the studio: what set styles, lighting setups, and shooting approaches produce the most versatile footage

**Drive platform and content intelligence**
-------------------------------------------

* Maintain a genuine, current relationship with TikTok, Meta, and emerging short-form platforms: scrolling with a critical eye, not just awareness
* Curate a regular inspiration feed for the team: specific content examples with notes on why they work, what the craft decisions are, and how we could produce something similar in our studio
* Know the difference between a format worth adopting and a trend worth skipping, and be able to make the case either way
* Bring fresh creative references when the team’s output starts feeling formulaic or dated

**Build the team’s creative instinct**
--------------------------------------

* Give Creative Strategists feedback on CSPs and scripts that builds their creative eye over time, not just fixes the brief in front of them
* Run regular creative review sessions and inspiration shares that create a shared language for what “good” means at Creative Milkshake
* Be the person the team brings work to when they're not sure if it's there yet, and give them an answer they can trust

**Own CM’s creative identity externally**
-----------------------------------------

* Approve CM's own social content and website portfolio: what we put out about ourselves should reflect the standard we hold for clients
* Help define and document CM’s creative POV over time: the format instincts, the aesthetic signatures, the things that make our content recognizably ours

**Who you are**
===============

We’re not filtering on titles. We're looking for a specific type of person: someone with a sharp creative eye for what works on social, who wants to use that experience to raise the quality of an entire studio's output.

* 3–7 years of hands-on experience in video production, editing, content creation, or a creative role at a social-first agency or DTC brand. You've made things, not just briefed them
* A genuine, current feel for short-form social content: you scroll TikTok and Meta with a critical eye, you notice what’s working before it’s obvious, and you can describe the craft decisions behind it in specific terms
* Ability to understand paid media and performance marketing reports to inform creative decisions
* Real editing experience, or close enough collaboration with editors, that you speak the language of the edit
* Enough on-set or production experience to spot when a storyboard isn’t going to translate, and know what to do about it
* The ability to tell a good ad from a great one in seconds, and explain why in a way the person who made it can actually use
* Feedback that is specific, timestamped, and producible, not vague creative notes that leave people guessing
* High EQ: you can give honest creative feedback without damaging the confidence or the relationship of the person on the other end
* Comfortable with ambiguity and pace: we're building systems while operating at volume
* Fluent in English, confident presenting creative rationale to clients when needed

**Backgrounds that tend to produce this person**
================================================

There’s no single path. People who are great at this role often come from one of these places:

* A video editor or post-production lead who has developed a strong creative eye for social, and wants to work upstream on quality rather than just executing edits
* A UGC creator or content creator who has built a real, granular understanding of what performs and why, and wants to bring that instinct to a studio environment at scale
* A creative producer who sits between strategy and production, has strong taste, and wants to formalise that into a quality leadership role
* A social content lead or in-house creative at a DTC brand who has been hands-on with short-form video and wants to take their creative judgement further

**What they all share: they’ve made things, they have taste, and they can teach it.**

**You’ll thrive here if…**
==========================

* You get genuinely excited about the craft of short-form video: the hook, the cut, the text timing, the sound. You find it hard to watch a mediocre ad without knowing what you'd fix
* You want a role where your creative instinct directly improves what goes out the door every week
* You’re energised by the challenge of holding a high standard at volume: lots of content, lots of clients, fast turnarounds
* You want to shape creative culture from the inside: setting a standard, building the resources that make a team better, defining what “good” means at a growing studio
* The idea of helping a UGC studio move toward elevated social-first content over the next couple of years sounds like exactly the right moment to join

**This role isn’t for you if…**
===============================

* You’ve only worked in creative strategy or performance marketing and haven’t been hands-on with video production or editing
* Your creative background is in brand identity or traditional advertising rather than short-form, social-first content
* You prefer to stay in the strategic or conceptual space and find production and editing detail less interesting
* You’re primarily looking for a people-management role. Your influence here comes through creative expertise, not team size

**What we offer**
=================

* Creative Milkshake Stipends (mental health, healthcare & internet)
* Time Off: 21 days PTO + 7 Paid Sick Days; company closure: 2 weeks at year-end (estimated: December 22 – January 5)
* Maternity/Paternity Leave
* Yearly Salary Review
* Long Service Incentives (starting from 2 years)

title: DESIGN & CREATIVE DIRECTOR
description:
**Join Kave and help define the future of our design identity**

At Kave, we believe great brands are built through great products.

The products we create shape how people experience our brand, the spaces they live in and the stories they tell in their homes. Over the last decade, Kave has built a strong and internationally recognised design brand. As we enter our next chapter, our ambition is not simply to grow our catalogue, but to strengthen our point of view as a company. We want to develop an increasingly distinctive, recognisable and timeless design language.

We want every collection, every campaign and every customer touchpoint to feel unmistakably Kave. To help us achieve this, we are looking for a **Design & Creative Director**.

A strategic leader responsible for shaping the creative vision of Kave, connecting product design, brand expression and culture into one coherent and inspiring universe. This is a role for someone who deeply loves products and design, but who also understands that great products only reach their full potential when they are communicated, presented and experienced in the right way.

**Your Mission:**

As Design & Creative Director, you will define and evolve Kave's creative vision, ensuring that product, collections, storytelling and brand expression work together as one consistent and distinctive system.

You will lead the Design team, collaborate closely with the Brand and Marketing teams and help shape the creative identity that will guide Kave over the coming years.

You will not only influence what products we create.

You will influence how they are interpreted, communicated and experienced by millions of customers around the world.

**What You Will Do:**

**Define Kave's Creative and Design Vision**

* Define and evolve Kave's long-term creative vision.
* Build a distinctive design language that transcends trends and creates long-term brand equity.
* Establish clear creative principles around form, proportion, materiality, colour, finishes and functionality.
* Ensure all collections contribute to a coherent and recognisable Kave identity.
* Translate the company's ambition and values into tangible design principles.

**Shape Kave's Product Identity**

Working closely with the Design team and the Product organisation, you will:

* Help define the creative direction of collections and categories.
* Challenge, refine and elevate product concepts.
* Ensure a consistent design narrative across all product families.
* Balance innovation, functionality, commercial relevance and aesthetic quality.
* Contribute to defining what Kave should and should not become.

While our Principal Designers will remain key experts in product design and development, you will ensure that individual products contribute to a larger creative vision.

**Connect Product and Brand**

This will be one of the most important parts of the role.

You will work closely with Brand, Marketing, Retail and Content teams to ensure a seamless connection between what Kave creates and what Kave communicates.

Responsibilities include:

* Bringing product stories to life.
* Helping shape collection narratives.
* Participating in campaign ideation.
* Contributing to creative direction for launches and strategic moments.
* Collaborating on art direction, styling, retail experiences and visual storytelling.
* Ensuring product and brand evolve together rather than independently.

You should genuinely enjoy collaborating with marketing and brand teams and see communication as a natural extension of product creation.

**Lead and Develop the Design Team**

* Lead and inspire the Design team.
* Build a culture of excellence, creativity and accountability.
* Coach and develop design talent.
* Define future capabilities and organisational needs.
* Create an environment where creativity and execution coexist.
* Raise the overall level of creative thinking across the function.

Great design alone is not enough. We are looking for a leader capable of building a world-class team.

**Partner with Merchandising and Product Leadership**

Working closely with the Range Director and Product teams, you will:

* Contribute to category visions and product roadmaps.
* Help identify white spaces and future opportunities.
* Bring an independent creative perspective into portfolio decisions.
* Ensure that commercial ambitions never come at the expense of long-term brand differentiation.
* Balance business objectives with creative integrity.

The strongest collections emerge through collaboration between creative and commercial perspectives.

**Connect Kave to Design and Culture**

* Maintain a constant pulse on design, architecture, interiors, fashion, arts, materials and culture.
* Identify emerging movements and opportunities relevant to Kave.
* Build relationships with leading designers, studios, architects and creative talent.
* Help position Kave as a company with a distinctive and respected creative voice.

**Lead Strategic Collaborations**

* Identify collaboration opportunities with designers, creatives and cultural institutions.
* Define collections and initiatives that increase relevance and differentiation.
* Build an external creative ecosystem around Kave.
* Help strengthen Kave's reputation within the global design community.

**What We Are Looking For:**

**Experience**

* Significant experience in senior Design Director, Creative Director or similar leadership roles.
* Strong background in product design, furniture, interiors, lighting, home or design-led consumer brands.
* Proven experience developing products, collections and design languages.
* Experience leading and developing multidisciplinary creative teams.
* Strong understanding of product development, materials and manufacturing realities.
* Track record of collaborating closely with brand and marketing functions.

**Skills**

Creative Vision, Product Sensibility, Brand Thinking, Leadership, Collaboration and Cultural Curiosity

**Why Join Kave:**

* This role goes far beyond leading a design team.
* It is an opportunity to influence the future identity of a global design brand.
* You will help define the products we create, the stories we tell and the creative standards we set for the next decade.
* You will work at the intersection of design, product, culture and brand.
* And you will play a central role in building a company that aspires to become one of Europe's most admired home design brands.
* If you believe that great brands are built through great products, and that great products deserve great storytelling, we'd love to meet you.

title: Creative Director, Visual
description:
**Description**
**Some problems are too important for ordinary thinking.**
How do you change behavior at scale? Build trust when trust is hard to earn? Make something complicated feel simple? Get millions of people to see things differently—and do something about it?
  
  
These are the kinds of problems we work on at ICF Next. The stakes are high. The answers aren't obvious. And the work has to do more than look good.
  
  
We're looking for a
**Creative Director**
who loves that kind of challenge. Someone with a restless imagination, exceptional instincts and the ability to turn a difficult brief into an idea that feels inevitable once you've seen it.
  
  
Someone who knows great creative work doesn't happen by accident. It takes curiosity, conviction, craft and people who care enough to keep pushing.
  
  
**About ICF & ICF Next**
ICF is a global consulting and technology services company working on some of the most pressing challenges facing businesses, governments and communities. From energy and climate to public health, infrastructure and government, our teams bring deep expertise to problems that don't have easy answers.
  
  
ICF Next brings creativity into that equation.
  
  
We're writers, designers, strategists, technologists and creative thinkers working together to help organizations connect with people and move them to action.
  
  
We have the creative ambition of an agency and access to the expertise of a global consultancy. That combination gives us an unusual opportunity: to understand difficult problems from the inside, find the human story and create work that makes a difference in the real world.
  
  
There's no shortage of interesting briefs. The challenge is doing something extraordinary with them.
  
  
**The Role**
You'll lead creative across major client engagements, from the first conversation about a problem to the last detail of the finished work.
  
  
You'll find the idea that makes everything click. Set the visual direction. Push the thinking. Bring writers, designers, strategists and producers together around a shared ambition.
  
  
The work spans integrated campaigns, brand experiences, film, digital, social, experiential and whatever else the idea calls for.
  
  
You'll be expected to have a point of view, make decisions, challenge work that isn't good enough and know when to let a better idea win.
  
  
You'll also help shape the creative culture at ICF Next. Not through speeches about excellence, but through the work you make, the standards you set and the people you help develop.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Find the idea. Get beneath the brief, ask better questions and turn complicated challenges into original, compelling creative concepts.
* Set the standard. Bring a sharp eye, strong art direction and a deep respect for design, storytelling and execution. Care about the big idea and every detail that makes it work.
* Make people care. Take subjects that can be technical, sensitive or difficult to explain and make them clear, relevant and human.
* Think beyond the medium. Lead creative across digital, social, film, video, experiential, paid media, out-of-home and emerging platforms. Start with the idea, not the format.
* Make the team better. Inspire, mentor and challenge creatives. Give useful feedback. Recognize talent. Create the conditions for people to do the best work of their careers.
* Stand behind the work. Present ideas with clarity and conviction. Build relationships with clients. Know how to push without making it personal, and how to protect a strong idea while making it stronger.
* Get it made. Work across disciplines, manage competing priorities and navigate the realities of complex projects without losing sight of what made the idea worth pursuing.
* Stay curious. Explore new tools, technologies and ways of working, including AI, without confusing what's new with what's good.

**Who You Are**
You came up through art direction or design, but you've never thought of yourself as just a visual person.
  
  
You think in ideas. You understand the power of an image, the precision of a line of copy and the way everything comes together to tell a story.
  
  
You have taste. You have opinions. You can explain both.
  
  
You know the difference between a clever execution and a genuinely good idea. You can spot what's missing, see what's possible and help a team get there.
  
  
You're comfortable leading a room, but you listen. You know how to sell an idea without overselling it. And you're not afraid to roll up your sleeves when the work needs you.
  
  
You've worked on difficult briefs, with demanding clients and tight deadlines. You've learned that constraints aren't an excuse for mediocre work.
  
  
Most importantly, you still get excited when something great comes together. You haven't lost the instinct to make it better.
  
  
**What You Bring**
**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of creative experience in an agency, design studio or comparable environment, including senior-level creative leadership.
* A portfolio that shows exceptional conceptual thinking, art direction, design craft and integrated creative work.

Professional Skills
  
  

* Experience leading creative teams and developing campaigns across multiple channels.
* Strong visual storytelling, strategic thinking and presentation skills.
* The ability to take ambitious ideas from concept through production while managing complex projects, stakeholders and deadlines.

**Why ICF Next**
The problems we work on aren't always easy to explain. They don't always come with glamorous briefs or obvious answers.
  
  
That's what makes them interesting.
  
  
You get to work with people who know their subjects inside out, tackle challenges that affect how people live and make decisions, and bring your creative instincts to places where they're genuinely needed.
  
  
There's room here for big ideas. For unexpected thinking. For the kind of work that makes you proud of what you do.
  
  
**If you believe the hardest problems deserve the best creative minds, we'd like to meet you.**
Show us your work. Show us how you think.

title: Creative Director
description:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.
  
  
We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.
  
  
Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.
  
  
We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $30B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.
  
  
If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.
  
  
****The Role****
Most B2B software looks the same. A few companies have proven it doesn't have to: brands with real taste, that people follow, wear and want to work for.
  
  
Behind every CPG brand you love is a back office nobody sees: the finance lead chasing a deduction at 11pm, the sales team planning a promotion blind, the founder watching margin leak line by line. Confido exists for them. Your job is to tell their story, and ours, so well that people who have never heard the words "trade spend" want to be part of it.
  
  
This is a principal-level role. You'll be our first creative brand hire and the keeper of how Confido looks and feels, setting the creative direction for the company and holding the final call on the craft. A new strategy and identity are underway with our agency partner, and you'll take it from a set of guidelines to a brand with a point of view: one customers share, candidates join for, and competitors quietly copy.
  
  
You'll own every place someone meets us, from the website and launches to decks, ads, events, video and the brand moments inside our product. As the work grows, you'll build and direct a bench of specialists across illustration, motion, photography, video production, 3D, presentation design, web development and event fabrication. You'll report to our VP of Marketing and work closely with the founders.
  
  
****What You'll Do****

* Be the creative voice in the room. Partner with the founders and marketing leadership on how we tell our story and what the brand stands for
* Shape the brand from the ground up. Take the new identity from guidelines to a living system with a voice, a point of view and a standard people notice
* Find the story in the numbers. Turn customer outcomes, like $500K recouped for Feastables or revenue doubled with the same finance team at DUDE Wipes, into campaigns, films and stories people remember
* Make the invisible visible. Put the people, shelves, pallets and trucks of CPG at the centre of how we show up, never just another dashboard screenshot
* Own every surface. confido.com, launches, sales and customer decks, ads, social, email and the brand moments inside our product
* Create moments in the room. Concept and direct our booths, customer dinners and owned events so people leave talking about them. We care deeply about unreasonable hospitality - people should feel that across every experiential surface.
* Build your bench. Hire and direct specialists across illustration, motion, photography, video production, 3D, presentation design, web development and event fabrication, with the templates, intake and asset library that let them do their best work
* Make brand and product one. Partner with our product design team so every touchpoint feels like the same company

****What We're Looking For****

* 8+ years in brand design, art direction or creative direction, in-house, at an agency, or both, including time leading brand for a company or major client
* You're a storyteller first. You can take a complex, unglamorous idea and make people feel something about it
* A portfolio with a brand system you built or scaled, and work you're proud to show anyone
* Taste you can defend. You know the difference between good and world class
* Range: you can move from identity and web to a sales deck, a booth and a photo shoot in the same week
* Hands-on craft in Figma. You sweat the kerning and what the work does for the business
* You own work from concept to production, including vendors, printers, fabricators and budgets
* You're comfortable with ambiguity and speed, communicate clearly, and can hold an idea through founder and sales feedback

****Nice to Have****

* Brand experience at a B2B software or fintech company known for its design
* Experience working with or for CPG brands
* Motion design and video editing
* Designing and building websites in a no-code tool
* Experience leading designers or managing freelancers and agencies
* AI tools in your creative workflow, used as a multiplier rather than a gimmick

****🌴 Perks + Benefits****

* Equity — own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build
* Fully paid health coverage through Aetna — we cover 100% of employee premiums
* Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian
* Carrot Fertility Pro — comprehensive fertility and family-forming support
* 12 weeks of paid parental leave
* Unlimited PTO — plus regular 4-day holiday weekends we actually take
* 401(k) through Vestwell
* Paid relocation support — we’ll help you make the move to NYC
* Fully equipped workspace from day one — laptop, monitor, keyboard, and a $200 stipend to personalize your setup
* Team perks — catered Friday lunches, team dinners, and unlimited coffee + snacks featuring products from the brands we work with

title: Head of Brand & Sponsorship
description:
Capital.com is scaling fast, and this role makes sure that ambition shows up everywhere the brand does. Reporting to the Brand Director, you’ll own delivery end to end, turning brand strategy into standout campaigns and building a sponsorship and events function that makes every partnership work harder. It’s a hands-on role for someone as comfortable running a campaign timeline as negotiating a sponsorship deal or managing an event on-site. Working with the CMO, Head of Creative, PR and regional teams, you’ll have real influence over how Capital.com shows up globally as it pursues premiumisation and expansion.

### **Responsibilities:**

**Brand Campaigns**

* Own end-to-end delivery of Capital.com's big-ticket brand campaigns, turning the Brand Director's strategy into standout, well-executed work across markets
* Partner closely with the Head of Creative, who leads creative production, to ensure every campaign is built and delivered to a premium standard
* Work with market analysts and the PR team to align campaign timing, messaging and measurement
* Manage campaign budgets, timelines and sign-off across multiple markets and stakeholders
* Lead delivery across campaigns of every scale, from moments built around a global brand asset to local activity such as a UK spread betting campaign or a new performance-led campaign for the paid social team
* Feed into the strategic thinking behind paid social alongside the paid social team, for example how a new channel is seeded with initial paid support, or how an organic boosting strategy is agreed and backed with paid
* Bring imagination to how the brand shows up, finding new ways to express Capital.com's premiumisation and expansion ambitions through brand activity

**Sponsorship & Events**

* Own the sponsorship and events function end to end: evaluating and negotiating new opportunities, then delivering the activations that bring them to life
* Draw on activation support at global level from the events team and at local level from regional marketing leads and local offices, so delivery is never carried alone
* Evaluate opportunities across sport, conferences and other partnerships against clear criteria for brand fit, audience relevance and commercial value
* Lead negotiation and management of sponsorship contracts, protecting Capital.com's interests and tracking every commitment on both sides
* Build and maintain relationships with rights holders, sports marketing agencies and event partners as the primary point of contact
* Plan and deliver event activations and client hospitality end to end — suppliers, guest lists, merchandise, booths — working with the design team so every physical presence reflects the brand
* Collaborate with the CMO, regional marketing managers and regional CEOs to align sponsorship priorities across markets and activate global properties locally
* Work with Compliance and Legal to ensure all sponsorship and event activity meets regulatory requirements across Capital.com's jurisdictions
* Track and report on sponsorship performance and ROI, and build out the sponsorship and events team as the function grows

### **Requirements:**

* Senior experience delivering brand campaigns end to end — an account director or campaign delivery background rather than a pure strategy role
* Proven experience managing sponsorships, partnerships or events at a senior level, from deal negotiation through to on-site activation
* Confidence negotiating and managing commercial contracts, with the judgement to evaluate opportunities critically rather than just enthusiastically
* Strong end-to-end event management skills, including logistics, supplier management and hospitality delivered to a high standard
* Excellent relationship management — you build trust quickly with creative partners, rights holders and senior internal stakeholders alike
* The ability to work across a complex, multi-market stakeholder structure without losing pace or clarity
* Highly brand literate, with the instinct to spot opportunities and build a compelling case for the ones worth pursuing
* Comfortable building a function from a small base, with willingness to travel roughly 20% of the time for events and activations

### **Nice to have:**

* Existing relationships with sports rights holders, conference organisers or sports marketing agencies
* Agency-side background in sponsorship, experiential or brand campaign delivery
* Experience managing brand or sponsorship activity across multiple international markets simultaneously
* Familiarity with financial promotions rules as they apply to marketing, sponsorship and events
* Experience within a financial services or fintech business

### **What you will get in return:**

* Competitive Salary: We believe great work deserves great pay! Your skills and talents will be rewarded with a salary that makes you feel valued and motivated.
* Work-Life Harmony: Join a company that genuinely cares about *you*—because your life outside of work matters just as much as your time on the clock.
* Annual Performance Bonus: Your hard work doesn’t go unnoticed! Celebrate your achievements with a well-deserved annual bonus tied to your performance.
* Generous Time Off: Need a breather? Our annual leave policy lets you recharge and enjoy life outside of work without a worry.
* Employee Referral Program: Love working here? Share the love! Bring your talented friends on board and get rewarded for growing our awesome team.
* Comprehensive Health & Pension Benefits: From medical insurance to pension plans, we’ve got your back. Plus, location-specific benefits and perks!
* Workation Wonderland: Live your digital nomad dreams with 30 extra days to work remotely from anywhere in the world (some restrictions apply). Adventure awaits!
* Volunteer Days: Make a difference! Take two additional paid days each year to support causes you care about and give back to the community

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. The Mayor's Office is responsible for supporting the Mayor of London, Sadiq Khan.

* Communications
* Mayoral Operations
* Policy and Delivery
* Political and Public Affairs.

To direct and have overall responsibility for marketing strategy and delivery, providing high-level strategic marketing, brand and communications advice to the Mayor of London and Mayoral appointees including Deputy Mayors and Mayoral Directors

title: Head of Brand Marketing
description:
The Head of Brand Marketing will play a central role in building FitFlop as a modern global brand, translating brand strategy into ideas, stories and coordinated action across Product, Partnerships, Community, Activation, Creative, Digital and PR. This is a global brand-building role, with a mandate to move beyond traditional brand servicing. Working closely with the Global Brand Director and Creative Director, the Head of Brand Marketing will help shape how FitFlop shows up in the world, creating the strategic and creative thinking that keeps the brand fresh, relevant and distinctive across global markets and channels.

FitFlop is a challenger brand, and we need to make our investment work hard. This role requires someone entrepreneurial and creatively ambitious, able to spot opportunities, connect culture and consumer insight to compelling ideas, and find unexpected ways to engage people without relying on large budgets or a traditional campaign model. Success will come from building an agile, digital-first and content-led brand organisation: globally minded, culturally connected, commercially aware, and capable of moving quickly from insight and idea to execution.

**The Responsibilities**

**Global Brand Planning & Storytelling**

* Own annual and seasonal brand planning, translating global brand strategy into clear priorities, stories and opportunities across markets and channels.
* Build plans around a global consumer mindset, ensuring FitFlop develops as one connected global brand rather than a UK-led brand adapted for other markets.
* Work with Product, Creative, Community, Digital, Activation and global teams, to turn product and brand priorities into compelling consumer stories that build both brand and commercial demand.

**Creative Brand Thinking**

* Be a source of ideas and creative energy within the brand organisation, working closely with the Creative Director and teams to develop distinctive ways to bring the brand to life.
* Use consumer insight, culture and brand strategy to identify unexpected moments, partnerships, collabs, content and experiences that can generate attention and engagement.
* Challenge conventional approaches and help the organisation move from a small number of large campaigns towards a more agile ecosystem of content, storytelling and brand moments.

**Modern Brand & Content Planning**

* Champion a digital-first, content-led approach to brand building, ensuring ideas are designed to travel naturally across social, digital, community, PR, retail and commercial channels.
* Connect longer-term brand building with fast-moving cultural and consumer opportunities, enabling the organisation to respond with global pace and relevance.
* Create strong strategic briefs that give Creative and Activation teams clear direction while leaving space for creative ambition.

**Brand Governance & Global Leadership**

* Own the global brand framework, ensuring FitFlop is recognisable and consistent while allowing markets the freedom to be locally and culturally relevant.
* Build strong relationships with global and regional teams, providing direction, inspiration and the confidence to build the brand appropriately in their markets.
* Bring global thinking into the organisation, ensuring decisions reflect the scale of FitFlop’s international opportunity rather than a UK-centric perspective.
* Translate the global brand direction into internal brand programmes, communications and moments that build understanding, belief and consistency across teams and markets.

**Insight, Culture & Future Thinking**

* Keep the organisation connected to shifts in consumer culture, creativity, technology, marketing and the wider brand landscape.
* Translate consumer, cultural, market and competitive insight into ideas and clear implications for the brand.
* Look ahead, identifying emerging opportunities and challenging the organisation to continually evolve how FitFlop builds relevance and connection.

**Partnerships, PR & Strategic Initiatives**

* Own and lead the strategic direction for key brand partnerships, PR and communications, with a focus on multiple market agency direction, in-house teams, and partners, ensuring plans and programmes create meaningful stories and contribute to the wider brand reach or relevance.
* Lead priority strategic initiatives that can move FitFlop forward, bringing entrepreneurial thinking, a creative mindset, cultural relevance, and strong cross-functional leadership from idea through to delivery.
* Ensure brand activity works across both sell-in and sell-out, supporting commercial teams while building longer-term consumer demand.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead and develop the Brand Marketing team, shifting the emphasis from brand servicing towards proactive brand building, ideas and storytelling.
* Create a culture of accountability, curiosity, creativity and pace, setting the expectation that the team proactively brings ideas, opportunities and solutions rather than simply responding to requests.
* Act as a strong connector across the organisation, working collaboratively while having the confidence and gravitas to challenge thinking and raise the ambition of the work.

**Resource and Budget Accountability**

* Own and manage the Brand Marketing budget and resources within the strategic priorities set by the Global Brand Director, ensuring investment, people and external support are deployed effectively and deliver maximum brand and commercial impact.
* Maintain clear visibility of spend, commitments and resource requirements, proactively identifying where priorities or investment need to shift.

**The Person**

* Significant senior brand marketing or brand strategy experience, including global experience and experience across multiple brands.
* Proven experience building brands across international markets and channels, with a genuinely global rather than home-market-led perspective.
* Strong understanding of contemporary 360° brand building and how digital, content, social, community, PR, retail and commercial channels work together.
* Culturally connected and actively engaged with consumer culture, creativity and the wider brand landscape.
* Closely plugged into evolving marketing, content and brand trends, with a strong point of view on where modern brand building is heading.
* A strong storyteller, able to turn brand strategy, product and consumer insight into compelling ideas and narratives.
* Creative and entrepreneurial, with a challenger mindset and the ability to generate impact without relying on large budgets.
* Comfortable moving between long-term brand vision and agile, reactive opportunities, with the judgement to know when each is required.
* Proven people leader with gravitas, able to build capability, raise standards and develop a proactive, creative brand-building, ideas-led team.
* Strong presence and credibility, able to inspire, influence and challenge across functions, markets and seniority levels.
* Highly collaborative, with the ability to work closely with Creative while bringing a distinctive brand and consumer perspective.
* Strong personal drive, accountability and problem-solving ability, with the energy to create momentum in a fast-moving environment.

We recognise that not everyone will meet every requirement. If you’re excited about this role and feel like you could add value, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Creative Director
description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.
  
  
**Job Description**
Location:
  
  
London, GB
  
  
Condé Nast is a global media company, home to iconic brands including Vogue, GQ, Glamour, CN Traveller, Vanity Fair, Wired, The World of Interiors, House & Garden and Tatler, among many others.
  
  
We are headquartered in New York and London and operate in 32 markets worldwide, with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers across print, digital, video and social platforms.
  
  
Condé Nast thrives on collaboration, and our teams come together in the office four days a week (Monday - Thursday).
  
  
We value diversity of background, views and cultures. We celebrate people for their personal qualities, skills and contributions, recognising the power our brands have to influence and shape culture.
  
  
Condé Nast is a global media company producing the highest quality content with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers in 32 territories through print, digital, video and social platforms. The company’s portfolio includes many of the world’s most respected and influential media properties including Vogue, Vanity Fair, Glamour, Self, GQ, The New Yorker, Condé Nast Traveler/Traveller, Allure, AD, Bon Appétit and Wired, among others.
  
  
Based in our London office, this role helps to set the creative vision and leads the overarching delivery of global and UK branded content, advertiser partnerships, and brand marketing across Condé Nast’s editorial portfolio. As a culturally attuned, conceptual leader, you will drive 360° creative strategy that connects brands to culture at scale. You bring a track record of editorially inspired work, natural mentorship, and the capability to deputise for the Executive Creative Director—aiding in guiding the department vision, setting creative standards, and inspiring the wider team.
  
  
Reporting to the Executive Creative Director, you will partner with senior marketing, strategy, and sales leaders to shape major commercial opportunities, pitch transformative partnership ideas, and oversee cross-departmental execution with editorial teams. Success requires visionary storytelling, deep commercial strategy, and a sharp cultural perspective. The Creative Director oversees overall portfolio output, establishing the creative direction and directing senior talent on high-stakes, multi-platform briefs—from global luxury video campaigns to multi-market event sponsorships.
  
  
You excel at guiding cross-functional teams through complex, fast-paced workflows, bringing executive-level problem-solving and strategic clarity to every meeting. The ideal candidate ensures creative excellence while safeguarding Condé Nast’s brand authority, creative standards, and journalistic integrity across all commercial initiatives.
  
  
Individual & Team Responsibilities
  
  

* Develop bold multi-channel creative work that reflects the voice and ethos of all Condé Nast titles for advertisers across categories.
* Assign, collaborate with and direct the work of multi-disciplinary creatives suitable for each project (art directors, designers, etc).
* Apply strategic insights in order to craft inventive content, experiential solutions, and partnership ideas that align with audience data, brand ethos, and client objectives.
* Direct video and photo shoots with a focus on performance and editorial quality.
* Serve as the primary creative client liaison on campaigns—presenting work, managing feedback, and guiding creative integrity across production.
* Drive brainstorms and work hands-on when crafting proposals and presentations.
* Propose creative solutions that fit within the provided budgets.
* Ensure all commercial ideas authentically balance the voices and perspectives of our editorial brands with those of our advertising partners.
* Help build a thriving creative department; nurture talent, establish workflow efficiencies, and champion inclusive, forward-thinking creative culture.
* Deputise for the Executive Creative Director across key business forums, internal leadership meetings, and executive client pitches.

**Essential Skills & Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience as a creative lead in premium media or agency environments.
* A demonstrated appreciation for the subject matter and creativity of the brands you’ll represent at Condé Nast.
* Confidence working with and directing artists, experts, celebrities and creators as talent on commercial projects.
* Strong portfolio showcasing work across print, digital, video and events.
* Passion for brand marketing, with a sharp cultural perspective that informs consumer-facing campaigns.
* Skilled storyteller with excellent written, visual, and verbal presentation abilities.
* Extensive on-set experience and deep knowledge of video and photography production, from pre- to post-production (for digital and print).
* Demonstrated success managing creative teams and working within established systems to improve output and efficiency.
* A creative aesthetic emphasizing current standards in entertainment, fashion, luxury and design.
* Highly organized, adaptable and adept at prioritizing workloads in fast-paced environments.
* Ability to work fluently with collaborators in production - writers, DPs, photographers, editors, animators, and designers.
* Proficiency in Google Slides and treatment deck creation. Bonus: familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and editing software.

**Desired Qualities**

* Culturally informed - Current on music and entertainment, luxury and fashion, as well as knowledgeable about Condé Nast brands and culture. Additionally, have awareness of relevant artists, and creative vendors.
* Highly imaginative - You’re a conceptual creative with innovative ideas that challenge outdated approaches to content and the definition of “experiential.”
* Detail-oriented - Equally obsessed with creating memorable work and impactful campaigns that solve our client’s challenges.
* Agile and adaptable - Open to taking input from others and willing to take on essential tasks needed to get the job done.
* Think critically - You strive to come up with ideas that solve brand challenges, can manage multiple projects at once, and know when to pivot if something isn’t working.
* Have an ego-less attitude - You give credit where credit is due, bring a positive attitude to work and support your teammates in gaining visibility and opportunities.
* A natural mentor - You prioritize diversity, inclusivity, and representation in every stage of the creative process and empathy in team collaboration.

What benefits do we offer?
  
  

* 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays) and extra days of annual leave if you move house or want to volunteer.
* You’ll have access to a competitive pension scheme, Bupa Private Healthcare, Season ticket loans and eye tests.
* We offer a range of tools to support your wellbeing, including core hours, 10 remote days (from home or a country with a Condé Nast office location), access to our Employee Assistance Programme, corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.
* We’re a dog-friendly office, plus you’ll enjoy discounts and magazine subscriptions, keeping you up to date with all things Condé Nast.
* We encourage personal and professional growth through the Condé Nast Learning Hub, where you’ll find an extensive portfolio of learning courses and training available in local languages.
* Our Employee Resource Groups provide a platform for employees to identify shared objectives, exchange ideas, and work on community priorities for our global workforce.

**What happens next?**
If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply below, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.
  
  
***Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.***

title: AI-Enabled Creative Director (US-Based)
description:
As an
**AI-Enabled Creative Director**
, you will turn complex business challenges into compelling creative ideas while making AI an essential part of how creative work is developed and delivered.

You will lead multidisciplinary teams, shape creative direction, and confidently sell ideas to clients. Beyond using AI tools yourself, you will build and apply practical workflows that expand creative possibilities, improve production efficiency, and help your teams deliver exceptional work.

This role calls for both strong creative leadership and hands-on AI expertise. You know how to inspire people, make confident creative decisions, and use emerging technology to elevate the work without compromising originality, strategy, or quality.

Designity is a premium, AI-enabled and human-led Creative-as-a-Service platform. We help brands scale creative and marketing work through dedicated Creative Director-led teams. Our model brings together senior creative leadership, multidisciplinary talent, managed execution, and AI-enabled workflows so clients can move faster without lowering the standard.

**Why this role exists**

Designity is moving beyond Creative Directors who use AI for occasional tasks toward leaders who can integrate it meaningfully throughout client projects.

With each Creative Circle supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts, maintaining exceptional creative quality while managing continuous production requires smarter, more effective ways of working.

We need a Creative Director who can turn AI into a practical advantage: expanding creative possibilities when developing ideas, building workflows that streamline asset production, and helping creative teams work more effectively.

This role brings hands-on AI expertise into our existing Creative Director model. It is not a company wide AI systems position, but a client-facing creative leadership role that combines AI implementation with strong strategic thinking, independent decision-making, and end-to-end creative ownership.

**What you will be doing**

* **Set the creative vision**
  – Lead creative direction across multiple clients, industries, and disciplines, translating business objectives into compelling concepts, campaigns, brand identities, digital experiences, motion, and content.
* **Sell and champion creative ideas**
  – Present concepts with confidence, articulate the strategy behind your recommendations, and build buy-in from both clients and creative teams. Navigate objections assertively and constructively while protecting the integrity of the work.
* **Build and implement AI-enabled workflows**
  – Develop practical workflows for your client projects, combining AI tools to streamline asset creation, refinement, and production. Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive work, improve efficiency, and strengthen execution.
* **Expand creative possibilities through AI**
  – Use AI to explore new directions, challenge conventional approaches, and develop stronger creative solutions. Apply the technology where it adds meaningful value, not simply because it is available.
* **Lead and mentor multidisciplinary creatives**
  – Provide clear direction, actionable feedback, and support to designers, writers, motion specialists, and other creative professionals. Help teams strengthen their craft and incorporate AI effectively into their work.
* **Own the creative lifecycle**
  – Stay involved from the initial brief through final delivery, overseeing execution and quality control. Ensure every asset meets the highest standards of strategic relevance, originality, brand consistency, and production quality.
* **Collaborate closely with Creative Project Managers (CPMs)**
  – Partner with your CPM to align priorities, navigate feedback, and support smooth project execution while maintaining ownership of creative direction and outcomes.
* **Anticipate and resolve challenges**
  – Proactively identify creative or client issues, make confident decisions, and find solutions independently. Take responsibility for keeping creative work moving without relying on managerial escalation.

**What you will bring**

* **Around 8 years of relevant creative experience**
  , including at least
  **2 years in creative leadership and 2 years of hands-on experience applying AI to creative projects and production workflows**
  .
* **An outstanding creative portfolio with strong AI-enabled samples**
  , demonstrating strategic thinking, originality, and high-quality execution across creative disciplines. You can clearly explain your role, creative decisions, and the impact of AI on the final work.
* **Proven experience developing and implementing AI-powered creative workflows**
  , combining technologies such as Higgsfield, Weavy, or comparable tools to enhance creative development and production. Your expertise goes beyond basic prompting or isolated AI-generated assets.
* **A proactive, autonomous approach to problem-solving**
  , with the confidence to take initiative, anticipate challenges, and independently resolve creative or client issues without waiting for direction.
* **Exceptional organization and attention to detail**
  , with the ability to balance competing priorities, identify inconsistencies, maintain brand standards, and deliver high-quality work across multiple projects.
* **Assertive, persuasive communication skills**
  , with a demonstrated ability to pitch and sell creative ideas, defend recommendations, navigate difficult conversations, and build alignment among both clients and creative teams.
* **Experience leading and mentoring multidisciplinary creatives**
  , providing decisive direction, constructive feedback, and the motivation needed to bring ambitious ideas to life.
* **Strong creative and strategic judgment**
  , grounded in branding, storytelling, art direction, design, and audience-centered communication, with an understanding of responsible AI use and the importance of human oversight.
* **Experience managing a high volume and variety of creative deliverables**
  across multiple clients, brands, or products in fast-paced agency or in-house environments.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, along with the adaptability, reliability, and strong internet connection needed to succeed in a remote environment

**How we work**

Designity is remote, with a structured virtual office environment built for close collaboration, clear communication, and meaningful connection.

You will work within a
**Creative Circle alongside a Creative Project Manager (CPM) and a multidisciplinary team of creative professionals**
, supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts.

Your CPM partners with you on project coordination, timelines, priorities, and delivery. As the Creative Director, you lead creative strategy, guide the team, own the creative side of client relationships, and remain accountable for the quality of work from initial brief through final delivery.

**This role requires a high level of independence and accountability.**
You will operate autonomously without a Head of Department managing your day-to-day creative decisions or resolving routine client challenges on your behalf. We expect you to anticipate issues, communicate assertively, make sound decisions, and take ownership of solutions while keeping your CPM and creative team aligned.

**What this role offers**

* The opportunity to work alongside the top 1% of global creatives and marketers, in a multicultural environment that broadens your perspective and sharpens your craft
* Shape meaningful creative work across different brands, industries, and disciplines
* Collaboration with ambitious clients and multidisciplinary creative talent
* A fully remote environment with structured virtual collaboration
* W-2 role with health insurance and 401k benefits available after 90 days
* Paid time off to rest and recharge
* Professional growth and continued skill development
* A fast-moving, supportive environment that values creative thinking, accountability, and high standards
* Total compensation of $90,000–$110,000 USD based on your qualifications.

**We believe great teams are built on shared values:**

* Choose Positivity and lift those around you.
* Say It Straight with honesty and respect.
* Raise the Bar by never settling for average.
* Take Ownership of your work and your impact.
* Move with Purpose and make every action count.

**Success in this role means:**

* Delivering original, strategically strong creative work across multiple client accounts, maintaining exceptional quality from concept through final execution.
* Making AI a practical part of creative production by implementing workflows that expand creative possibilities and improve efficiency.
* Building trust and alignment with clients and creatives through persuasive presentations, confident leadership, and clear creative direction.
* Proactively resolving challenges, managing priorities independently, and maintaining strong organization and attention to detail.
* Elevating team performance through effective mentorship, practical AI adoption, and consistently high creative standards.

**Disclaimer:**

**When applying, please include an updated portfolio showcasing the work you would like us to consider, along with relevant project links, supporting work, or samples of AI Creative Workflows.**

**For collaborative projects, clearly specify your contribution and the areas you were responsible for.**

Our team reviews every submission carefully and will contact candidates who best fit the role within 2–3 weeks.

title: Creative Director, Filmmaker for Brand Storytelling
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.**Roku is changing how the world watches TV**

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What is the role?

The Creative Director/Filmmaker — Brand Storytelling leads the concept, development, and production of Roku-produced brand commercials, video idents, experience videos, and other high-impact brand films within the Creative Studio. This is a hands-on creative leadership role for an exceptional storyteller who can find the simple, ownable, and entertaining idea, shape compelling narratives within the world of Roku City, and guide the creative vision from first pitch through post-production. You will turn brand and business objectives into entertaining, visually distinctive work that strengthens Roku's cultural relevance, recognition, and audience connection. The role requires both creative ambition and practical fluency across editorial, animation, visual effects, sound, color, and finishing. You will lead stories that can be funny, surprising, emotional, or all three—using comedy, character, visual invention, live-action sensibility, animation, and emerging production techniques. This role partners closely with an AI-assisted, in-house production team to establish creative standards, develop treatments and scripts, direct development, and bring the work to life with speed, flexibility, and craft. You will be accountable for ensuring work is high-quality, on-brand, emotionally resonant, and delivered efficiently across campaigns, products, and global markets.

For California Only - The estimated annual base salary for this position is between $209,400 - $232,800.

Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location.

This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability.

We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they've used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

* Lead end-to-end creative development of Roku Creative Studio brand commercials, video idents, experience videos, and related brand storytelling—from brief and insight through concept, treatment, script, visual development, production, post-production, and final delivery
* Define the creative point of view for each project, establishing the story, tone, visual language, comedic approach, performance direction, pacing, sound, and craft standards
* Write, develop, or collaborate on scripts, treatments, storyboards, beat sheets, visual references, and production plans
* Direct the creative process across live-action-inspired, animation, visual effects, motion, and AI-assisted video approaches—identifying when each technique best serves the story
* Lead an in-house production model using AI-assisted and agentic workflows, maintaining a high bar for originality, quality, brand integrity, and responsible use of AI
* Collaborate with Brand Strategy, Copy, Marketing, Product, Devices, Advertising, and other cross-functional partners to translate business objectives into audience-first stories
* Present concepts and creative recommendations to senior stakeholders, building alignment while protecting the strength and distinctiveness of the work
* Champion a culture of experimentation, candor, generosity, humor, and creative excellence within the team
* Build and maintain relationships with select external creative, production, talent, and finishing partners when specialized support is needed
* Establish and evolve a portfolio of Roku brand storytelling that scales across campaigns, products, experiences, and global markets

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

* 10+ years of experience as a video creative director, filmmaker, director, or equivalent creative leader in a brand, agency, entertainment, studio, network, or production environment
* A strong portfolio demonstrating excellence in commercial filmmaking and visual storytelling, including brand films, commercials, idents, experience videos, or other high-impact video work
* Demonstrated ability to develop an idea from a brief into a clear, compelling concept and carry it through pre-production, production, and post-production workflows
* Exceptional visual storytelling skills, with a sharp eye for composition, camera, performance, pacing, production design, motion, sound, and editorial rhythm
* Experience creating comedy-driven work, including strong premise, character, timing, tone, surprise, and emotional payoff
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams of producers, editors, animators, designers, writers, technical artists, and production partners
* Ability to give clear, actionable feedback and inspire excellent work without creating unnecessary process or friction
* Comfort working in an evolving, AI-assisted production environment with genuine interest in agentic creative workflows and emerging approaches to filmmaking
* Sound judgment around the responsible use of AI, including originality, rights, likeness, representation, confidentiality, and brand safety
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex creative choices simple and persuasive for a range of stakeholders
* A collaborative leadership style and a positive, creative team dynamic
* Experience with AI-assisted video tools, virtual production, procedural workflows, or AI-assisted editorial, animation, and visual effects is highly valued
* Experience developing global brand work and adapting stories across markets, formats, and cultural contexts
* A strong understanding of the streaming ecosystem and the role that simplicity and delight play in the customer experience
* A portfolio or reel showcasing commercial, visual storytelling, comedy, and animation work (please include links and passwords, if applicable)
* Bachelor's and/or master's degree in film, communications, design, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience

**What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?**

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

**What are some of the benefits?**

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

**Accommodations**

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

**What should I know about Roku's culture?**

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

**Responsibilities**

* Own generative output end to end for paid social and native: stills that hold the same character across every shot, AI video, lip-sync, and generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to organized, tagged, editor-ready footage. Set the quality bar for generated work and enforce it.
* Architect the systems that make generation scale past any one person: pipelines, prompt libraries, character reference libraries, internal tooling, and the automation that connects them.
* Measure how well AI content, and the systems that produce it, are working. What a finished asset costs to make, how long a job takes from approved script to editor handoff, how often work is accepted on the first pass, and how generated work performs in market against everything else we run.
* Help raise the AI fluency of the whole creative team. Work with Creative Directors and their teams to design AI-enabled tools, systems, processes that improve quality and quantity of output.

**Requirements**

* 7+ years in creative, production, or content, with at least the last 2 years hands-on in generative AI video and image production. You have stood up an AI capability inside a creative org before.
* A real grounding in direct-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built, and you can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished.
* Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted work that ran as paid creative, with an honest account of what you made versus what the model made, and how it performed. You can hold character and continuity across a whole spot, work out why a render broke instead of re-rolling blindly, and get work through platform filters yourself.
* Deep, current fluency with the generative tools: image models that can hold several characters consistent, AI video both with and without native audio, lip-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on the trade-offs, not a list of tool names.
* You architect the tooling. You can map out the systems and automations the team needs, build working versions yourself in tools like n8n, Gumloop, or Make, and brief engineering clearly enough that they can build the rest.
* Experience leading people or a function, whether as a manager, a team lead, or the person who built a capability others came to depend on. You can make the case for a hire and then hold the bar you set.
* Comfort working inside compliance rails: regulated-category claims, platform ad policy, and partner brand guardrails.
* Clear written communication, and the confidence to hold your position with senior people outside Creative, including the buyers and the executive team.
* Comfortable in a start-up style operating environment where the tools, and sometimes the plan, change under you.

****STRONG PLUSES****

* Video editing or motion and VFX background (Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci) that lets you hand editors better material and speak their language.
* Familiarity with DAM systems (Air, Frame.io, or comparable) and production project-management tooling.
* Comfort reading performance dashboards (Looker, Tableau, in-platform reporting) to close the loop between what rendered and what converted.
* A track record of forming a real point of view on brand-new tools fast, because these tools turn over monthly.

title: Creative Strategist, Mexico
description:
**Job Description**
**Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.**
Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
  
  
Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
  
  
**Where And How You Can Work**
Alongside our global campuses, we also collaborate with talented contractors and freelancers from all over the world to help us achieve our crazy big goals. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role we’re focusing on Mexico City so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.
  
  
This role is a 12 month engagement, working full time hours per week.
  
  
**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**
As Creative Strategist for Mexico, you’ll be the creative performance engine behind Canva’s paid marketing in the region.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of Creative, Growth, and Data - combining cultural insight, analytical depth, and creative instinct to continuously improve our performance marketing output. You won’t be running bids day-to-day - you’ll be driving the creative strategy that makes those campaigns win.
  
  
If you love decoding what makes a hook scroll-stopping, turning insights into structured testing, and raising the creative bar sprint after sprint, this role is for you.
  
  
**At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On**

* Leading the full creative cycle - research, briefing, production, and performance review — running weekly sprint cycles that balance quick-win iterations with bigger creative swings, and feeding learnings back to the broader team after every sprint
* Digging into performance dashboards to spot winning patterns, diagnose underperformance, and translate insights into clear, actionable creative direction that drives the next round of concepts
* Directing and collaborating with video editors, designers, writers, and local creators to produce high-quality work across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging channels - briefing and reviewing content to keep it on-brand, culturally relevant, and platform-optimised
* Bringing deep cultural fluency to every brief - identifying Mexican audience behaviours, regional trends, and platform dynamics that shape compelling, locally resonant storytelling
* Working closely with media buyers, data science, and the LatAm Growth Marketing Lead to make sure creative insights translate into measurable business outcomes
* Driving CRO initiatives that improve acquisition journeys and lift conversion efficiency across key touchpoints
* Using AI tools to accelerate ideation, research, asset generation, and analysis - and staying across emerging formats and creative tech that give the team an edge

**You’re Probably a Match If**

* You have solid experience in growth or performance marketing with a strong focus on creative strategy - and you've worked hands-on across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube
* You can lead structured creative testing and sprint frameworks, analyse what's working, and turn those learnings into clear briefs for the next cycle
* You have strong creative instinct - you know what makes a hook scroll-stopping, a format compelling, and a concept scalable across channels
* You're fluent in Spanish and English, with a sharp eye for tone, nuance, and cultural resonance for Mexican audiences
* You have experience briefing, directing, and iterating with creative talent — video editors, designers, writers, and creators - coaching them to produce performance-driven work
* You're confident using dashboards and analytics tools to inform decisions and optimise creative at scale
* You use AI tools to accelerate your workflow and improve output quality

We're Canva's LatAm Marketing group, and our mission is to make Canva the most loved brand in the region. We build culturally resonant, high-impact marketing across Latin America - combining bold creative storytelling with sharp performance thinking to drive visibility and growth, market by market. Mexico is a key focus for us right now, and this role sits right at the heart of that ambition.

We make decisions to engage contractors based on your experience, skills and passion.
  
  
When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
