At Glovo, we are looking for a passionate, strategic Sr. Lead FCF planning to join our Finance Performance department at our Barcelona headquarters. Reporting directly to the Head of FP&A / Finance Performance Director, you will own the global Free Cash Flow planning ecosystem across 21+ markets, translating complex multi-entity P&L and Balance Sheet dynamics into trusted, forward-looking cash forecasts. Over the next 12–18 months, your mission is to transform our spreadsheet-based FCF modeling architecture into a highly accurate, driver-based forecasting engine, partner with C-level leadership on strategic capital allocation, and drive proactive working capital initiatives to safeguard liquidity and fund expansion—all while acting as the functional manager and technical mentor for our FCF Sr. Analyst.

**THE JOURNEY**

* Own the global multi-entity FCF forecasting and rolling plan framework end-to-end in complex spreadsheets, ensuring dynamic integration with P&L, Balance Sheet, and working capital drivers across 21+ operating markets.
* Master the navigation of enterprise FP&A tools (Anaplan, OneStream) and ERPs (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics) to seamlessly pull, interrogate, and reconcile Actuals and P&L planning inputs into the core spreadsheet FCF model.
* Act as the practical manager and mentor for the FCF Sr. Analyst, reviewing their analytical outputs, guiding their professional development, and establishing robust operational redundancy during critical forecasting and closing cycles.
* Drive proactive liquidity optimization initiatives (partnering with Accounting, Treasury, Tax, and local operations to unlock cash pipelines).
* Act as the primary bridge to local Finance teams to capture, challenge, and refine country-level operational inputs; drive a unified FCF forecasting methodology by benchmarking regional models, scaling best practices, and implementing standardized driver-based templates across all entities.
* Serve as the primary finance counterpart for Delivery Hero (DH) Group on all FCF, liquidity, and cash projections; ensure seamless alignment on corporate methodology, reporting standards, and strategic cash flow inputs for group-level consolidation.
* Serve as the primary operational bridge and strategic partner between FP&A, Treasury, Tax, and Delivery Hero central finance, constructively challenging operational assumptions and presenting FCF risks/sensitivity scenarios directly to C-level executives.
* Design robust simulation models to stress-test the FCF impact of major corporate or business decisions.

 **Qualifications**

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE**

* Fluency in English
* 8+ years of progressive professional experience in Corporate Finance, FP&A, or Strategic Finance, with a heavy specialization in Cash Flow planning and liquidity modeling.
* Expert-level spreadsheet modeling capabilities (Excel / Google Sheets): proven track record of building and maintaining integrated 3-statement financial models from scratch across complex, multi-currency legal structures.
* Deep, non-negotiable understanding of technical accounting principles, balance sheet mechanics, and operational cash drivers (specifically DPO, DSO, and inventory cycles). You know how accounting entries flow across the three statements and how operational shifts translate directly into working capital and cash impact.
* FP&A & ERP Systems Navigation: working fluency in navigating enterprise FP&A tools (Anaplan, OneStream) and major ERPs (SAP, MS Dynamics) to interrogate upstream financial data, P&L planning outputs, and actuals.
* Demonstrated leadership & Coaching ability: proven experience guiding, mentoring, and reviewing the work of mid-level analysts, with the ability to set high analytical standards and direct daily priorities effectively without needing formal administrative authority.
* Deep financial & Accounting mastery: thorough understanding of corporate accounting principles, balance sheet dynamics, working capital drivers (DSO, DPO, inventory), and indirect/direct cash flow mechanics.
* Proven track record of value creation: demonstrated ability to go beyond reporting to identify, quantify, and execute tangible cash-generation opportunities.
* Exceptional communication & C-Level influencing: ability to translate complex cash dynamics into clear executive narratives, challenge cross-functional assumptions, and align senior leadership.

**NICE TO HAVES:**

* Spanish language
* Prior experience in high-growth Tech, E-commerce, or capital-intensive/marketplace business models.
* Familiarity with advanced analytics tools (SQL, Python) or BI visualization platforms (Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
* Formal financial modeling or professional finance certifications (CFA, CIMA, CPA).

title: SDR Manager
description:
We are looking for a hands-on sales development leader to build and run Oppizi's outbound engine from Barcelona. You will manage our SDR team, carry your own pipeline target, and own the outbound motion end to end: lists, sequences, deliverability, coaching, and conversion. If you know outbound as a craft and not just as a dashboard, and you want to build the machine rather than inherit it, we want to hear from you.

**What's Oppizi**

Oppizi is the first major multi-channel player in offline performance marketing. We have built a technology platform that enables the tracking, scaling and optimisation of flyering, door-to-door, direct mail, and insert media campaigns. We operate in 14 countries, including the US, UK, Canada, Australia, France, Germany, Spain, and more. We are proud to work with flagship accounts such as Uber, DoorDash, Chipotle, Deliveroo, and many others.

Our tech team of 50 is AI-first and ships fast. We are currently building an AI agent platform that will power our product for the next five to ten years, led by a Chief AI Officer who previously worked at NASA and SpaceX. We operate in a category with very few real competitors, against incumbents who are growing at 5% a year.

**The role**

Reporting to the COO, you will lead Oppizi's SDR team in Barcelona and personally contribute to pipeline. This is explicitly a player-coach role. You will spend part of your week prospecting your own accounts and the rest managing, coaching, and building the systems that make the team better.

We do not have a finished outbound playbook. We have strong logos, a differentiated product, and a team that needs a leader who knows how to build sequences that land, coach reps who are ramping, and turn activity into qualified pipeline. That build is the job.

**Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership and Coaching**

* Manage, coach, and develop the Barcelona SDR team, owning ramp, performance, and progression
* Run weekly one-to-ones, call reviews, and pipeline reviews with a consistent methodology
* Set clear activity and outcome KPIs, and hold the team to them
* Build a performance culture grounded in accountability, feedback, and continuous improvement
* Own hiring and onboarding for the SDR team as it grows

**Personal Pipeline (The Player Half)**

* Carry your own quota for qualified meetings and pipeline generated
* Personally prospect into strategic and enterprise accounts, leading by example
* Stay hands-on in the tools every week; you should be writing sequences, not just approving them
* Run discovery calls and hand over cleanly to Account Executives and General Managers

**Outbound engine and process**

* Own the full outbound motion: list building, segmentation, sequencing, multichannel cadence, and follow-up
* Own email deliverability end to end, including domain warming, inbox rotation, and sender reputation
* Continuously test and improve messaging, subject lines, open rates, reply rates, and meeting conversion
* Build the objection handling library and the qualification framework the team runs on
* Partner with Marketing on ICP definition, ABM target lists, and campaign follow-up

**Reporting and Revenue Operations**

* Own CRM hygiene and data quality for the top of the funnel
* Report weekly on activity, pipeline generated, conversion rates, and forecast to the COO
* Run the business off data, not anecdote
* Leverage AI-powered sales tools and Oppizi's internal agent stack to raise team productivity

**You might thrive in this role if you:**

* **Know outbound as a craft.** You have personally written the sequences, fixed the deliverability, and cracked the list that finally worked.
* **Coach rather than supervise**. You have taken a ramping SDR and made them good, and you can point to who and how.
* **Lead from the front.** You are comfortable carrying your own number while developing the team around you.
* **Build where there is no playbook.** You bring structure to ambiguity instead of waiting for it to arrive.
* **Move with urgency.** You operate fast, adapt quickly, and prefer shipping to planning.
* **Communicate with precision**. Whether it is a cold email, a call review, or a weekly report, you are clear and credible.
* **Are genuinely ambitious.** You want the next role after this one, and you want to earn it by building something.

**Why should I Apply?**

* **Build the engine, don't inherit it**. There is no outbound playbook here yet. You will write it, and it will carry your fingerprints.
* **Sell a genuinely differentiated product**. Oppizi operates in a category with very few real competitors and serves enterprise clients you already know.
* **Real progression**. This role sits directly under the COO with visibility across the leadership team. Strong performance opens the path to Head of Sales Development or a broader commercial mandate.
* **Work with exceptional people.** We are builders, not politicians. The Oppizi culture values directness, curiosity, and getting things done.
* **Join at the right time**. We are scaling across 14 markets with a growing enterprise client base and significant product investment.

  
**Requirements**  

* 5 to 8 years in B2B sales development or inside sales, with at least 2 years directly managing an SDR or BDR team
* Demonstrable track record of building and scaling an outbound engine in B2B SaaS, MarTech, or AdTech
* Deep hands-on expertise in outbound: sequence design, deliverability, domain and inbox management, multichannel cadence
* Proven coaching ability, with concrete examples of reps you ramped and developed
* Experience prospecting into enterprise or mid-market accounts, not just SMB volume
* Strong command of CRM and outbound tooling; experience with HubSpot, Clay, and Lemlist is a strong plus
* Comfortable being measured on both team output and a personal number
* Fluent English is mandatory. Fluency in either French or German is also required, while Spanish is a strong plus.
* Based in Barcelona or willing to relocate. This is an on-site role
* Comfortable with occasional international travel

  
**Benefits**

**Compensation**

  

* Competitive base salary.
* Annual performance bonus.
* Employee stock options.

**Benefits**

* Private health insurance (Alan) after successful completion of probation.
* 22 days annual leave plus 3 additional convenio days.
* Two paid volunteer days each year.

**Flexibility**

* Hybrid working model with four days per week in our Barcelona office.
* Occasional opportunities to work remotely from another location.
* Right to disconnect outside working hours, except in exceptional business situations.

**Interested? Apply now!**  
Only candidates who have been selected for an interview will be contacted.  
Thank you for understanding.

title: General Ledger Accountant
description:
**Company Description**

SLS Barcelona, a five-star urban resort of extraordinary experiences, brings a new variety of seaside glamour, indulgence and excellence to Barcelona’s waterfront district of Port Forum. Here the hallmarks of an SLS wonderland – playful ambiance, VIP treatment, and theatrical experiences - meet idyllic views to set a lavish stage for the extraordinary to unfold. The only 5-star hotel in the city to feature a terrace off every guestroom (471 in total), SLS Barcelona is all-encompassing in its delight, offering an array of exclusive amenities including rooftop dining and bars, three inviting swimming pools, a spacious 800 square-meter ballroom with abundant natural light, break out rooms catering to all size of meetings, a rejuvenating spa, and a state-of-the-art fitness centre. Say farewell to the ordinary, and hello to the extraordinary!

 **Job Description**

**What you’ll do**

We are looking for a Geneal Ledger Accountant to join the team at SLS Barcelona. Under the guidance of the Assistant Director of Finance, you’ll support the Finance department on the financial operations of the hotel while managing hotel assets and ensuring a centralized accounting environment.

  

* Maintains and consolidates all financial transactions in the general ledger.
* Ensures all assets are duly capitalized
* Ensures all necessary adjustments are done before month end
* Support internal and external audits
* Implement internal controls to prevent imbalances and ensure company procedures are in place
* Work closely with accounts payable and receivable teams to ensure timely postings
* Maintain Contract Log
* Resolve queries from suppliers
* Check vouchers, prepare payments and forward to FC for authorization.
* Perform or assist in the performance of month-end closing. Input General Ledger entries and journal vouchers as required. Ensure that appropriate supporting information is collated and submitted.
* Perform or assist in performing balance sheet reconciliations and bank reconciliations and oversee the process of credit extension and collection of overdue accounts.
* Oversee internal hotel audits and report anomalies to management team and ensuring that audit policies and procedures (Control Self-Assessment) are being followed.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reports in accordance with reporting calendars, ensuring that all reports are submitted on a timely basis.
* Conduct necessary procedures to meet all legal requirements

  
**Qualifications**

**What we are looking for...**

* Bachelor’s degree in hospitality, business administration or related field.
* +2 years of experience in a hotel’s accounting department.
* Ability to multitask, work in a fast-paced environment and have a high-level attention to detail.
* Fluent in Spanish and English.
* You take ownership of important issues, solve problems, and make effective decisions.
* You learn quickly and adapt to SLS’s unique culture.
* You are humble and open to ideas. We leave our ego at the door and help get things done.
* You’re up for doing things differently and trying (almost) everything once.
* You want to be part of a team that works hard, supports each other and has fun along the way.

  
**Additional Information**

**What's in it for you...**

* The opportunity to join an innovative, fast-growing, international group that’s committed to not just building new hotels but building a global brand.
* The chance to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.
* Become part of a team that’s very passionate about creating great hospitality experiences and exploring new locations at every opportunity.
* A competitive package and plenty of opportunity for development.
* Excellent discounts across the entire Ennismore family of brands.

SLS is part of Ennismore, a creative hospitality company rooted in culture and community, with a global collection of entrepreneurial and founder-built brands with purpose at their heart. Ennismore is a joint- venture with Accor, formed in 2021.

At Revolt we build brands the world wants more of.  
Revolt is a global brand communications agency specialising in positive impact, working with major brands, fast‑growing businesses and NGOs.  
  
Sat at the intersection of brand communications, impact and business, we help brands build their corporate reputations, brand equity and internal culture.  
  
We operate like a hybrid between a strategy consultancy and a creative agency: intellectually rigorous, creatively ambitious, and values‑driven  
  
Revolt is part of Anthesis, the world's leading specialist in sustainability, meaning everything we do is backed by substance and technical rigour.  
  
We are looking for a Senior Business Consultant to join our team. This is a hands-on role for someone who is confident leading and delivering projects independently while contributing to strategic discussions and commercial growth opportunities.

This role does not have direct line management responsibilities and requires someone who is highly organised, commercially minded, relationship-driven, and exceptionally strong in project management.

* Lead the day-to-day management and delivery of client projects and campaigns, ensuring work is delivered on time, within budget, and to a high standard.

* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to identify growth opportunities.
* Understanding of project profitability, budgeting, and commercial delivery.

title: Key Account Manager (Dairy and Beverages)

**Key Account Manager - Beverage/ Dairy**

You will work closely with leading food and beverage companies, helping them turn consumer insights and market opportunities into innovative products that find their way into **supermarkets, restaurants and foodservice channels**.

This is more than an account management role. You will have the opportunity to **c-create customer strategies, identify new business opportunities and bring together commercial insight, creativity and flavour expertise** to create solutions that make a real difference for our customers and consumers.

You will join an international and collaborative environment where we encourage curiosity, challenge conventional thinking and give people the space to grow. We value different perspectives and believe that diverse teams create better ideas and stronger results.

You will be based in Sant Celoni and report directly to the **Commercial Director Iberia.**

**Your impact**

In this role, you will:

* **Own and grow key customer relationships** by developing a deep understanding of their business, challenges and ambitions, and turning these insights into profitable growth opportunities.
* **Drive commercial success** across both existing and new accounts, taking responsibility for sustainable top and bottom-line growth.
* **Become a trusted business partner to your customers.** Using a consultative selling approach, you will look beyond the immediate request to uncover opportunities and create additional value.
* **Build new business.** You enjoy opening doors, identifying promising leads and turning opportunities into long-term customer partnerships.
* **Shape customer and account strategies** based on your knowledge of the Iberian food and beverage market, consumer trends and customer priorities.

* **Continue to grow yourself.** You will work in an environment where commercial insight, creativity, science and technology come together, creating plenty of opportunities to learn and develop.

**What you bring**

You are an experienced commercial professional who combines **strong customer orientation with a genuine drive to grow the business**. You are curious about what makes customers and consumers tick and know how to translate that understanding into commercial opportunities.

* A **proven track record of commercial success in the B2B beverage and dairy industry**.

* Strong **commercial judgement and negotiation skills**, with the confidence to manage complex customer relationships.
* The ability to operate both **strategically and hands-on**, moving comfortably from developing an account strategy to driving the next concrete action.
* Excellent **communication and relationship-building skills**. You connect easily with different stakeholders, influence effectively and know how to build trust, both internally and externally.
* A **collaborative mindset** and the ability to bring together technical, creative and commercial experts around a common customer opportunity.

You are someone who doesn't simply manage accounts. **You create opportunities.** You are commercially ambitious, genuinely curious about your customers and enjoy connecting the dots between **consumer needs, customer challenges and what our innovation teams can make possible**.

If you enjoy building relationships, winning new business and seeing an idea develop into a product that eventually reaches consumers, **we would love to meet you.**

**What we offer:**

* **Annual Bonus:** We recognize and reward your hard work and contributions with an annual bonus.
* **Home Office 1/week:** Work-life balance is important; you can work from home up to one day a week.

* **Lease Car**

title: PICs@ICFO Strategic Initiative: Postdoctoral Researcher in TGV Metallization and Seed-Layer Processes
description:
As part of the **PICs@ICFO Strategic Initiative**, ICFO coordinates PIXEurope, a flagship **Pilot Line funded under the European Chips JU program**, focused on Advanced Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs) through which ICFO is advancing frontier technologies, including optical interposers for Co-packaged optics for next-generation optoelectronic and photonic devices.

To strengthen this initiative, ICFO is seeking a highly motivated Engineer/Scientist with strong expertise in thin-film deposition and metallization of high-aspect-ratio Through-Glass Vias (TGVs).

**Position Overview:**,

We offer a post-doctoral position to a scientist with hands-on experience in thin-film deposition, surface preparation, and metallization for semiconductor, MEMS, or advanced-packaging applications. The successful candidate will develop, optimize, and scale reliable adhesion, barrier, and conductive seed layers inside high-aspect-ratio glass vias, ensuring continuity and compatibility with subsequent copper plating and interconnection processes.

**Key Responsibilities:**,

The selected candidate will be expected to:

* Develop and optimize seed-layer deposition processes for high-aspect-ratio Through-Glass Vias
* Develop substrate cleaning, glass-surface activation, and adhesion-promotion processes
* Develop adhesion, barrier, and conductive seed stacks such as Ti/Cu, Cr/Cu, TiW/Cu, and related systems
* Optimize sputtering, evaporation, electroless, ALD or CVD-assisted, and hybrid deposition approaches
* Achieve continuous and conformal seed coverage along via entrances, sidewalls, and exits
* Characterize thickness, morphology, resistivity, adhesion, continuity, and wafer-level uniformity
* Identify and mitigate shadowing, seed discontinuity, oxidation, delamination, and cracking
Coordinate with the laser and glass team to align via geometry and surface condition with seeding, plating, and interconnection requirements  

  
This position will report to the **Prof. Dr. Valerio Pruneri, Director of the European Chips JU Pilot Line PIXEurope.**

PIXEurope is co-funded by the Chips Joint Undertaking and national funding authorities of the Participating States, Spain, Ireland, The Netherlands, Finland, Belgium, Portugal, Poland, Austria, France, Italy, United Kingdom. In particular, it is co-funded by Spain through the Ministry for Digital Transformation and Civil Service under reference CJU-010000-2025-0005, as part of the Recovery, Transformation and Resilience Plan (PRTR).

Applicants must hold a PhD in materials science, chemistry, chemical engineering, electrical engineering, microelectronics, physics, microengineering, or related fields, or equivalent research experience.

Candidates should demonstrate expertise in the following areas (not all mandatory, but strongly preferred):

* Thin-film deposition by sputtering, evaporation, ALD, CVD, or electroless methods
* Metallization processes for semiconductor, MEMS, microfabrication, or advanced-packaging applications
* Surface preparation, activation, and surface chemistry of glass or dielectric materials
* Metal-to-dielectric adhesion and adhesion/barrier/seed-layer material systems
* Metallization or coating of high-aspect-ratio three-dimensional structures
* Redistribution layer patterning and fabrication
* Electrical and structural characterization of thin films and interconnects
* Cleanroom processes, safety procedures, and fabrication protocols
Process optimization, reproducibility, failure analysis, and wafer-level uniformity  

Desired (but not required):

* Direct experience with Through-Glass Via or Through-Silicon Via metallization
* Experience with FIB/SEM cross-sections, X-ray inspection, four-point-probe measurements, or via-resistance testing
* Experience with reliability testing, thermomechanical stress, process scale-up, or wafer-level packaging
* Experience with glass surface processing will be evaluated as a strong asset
Experience with electroless deposition, ALD-assisted seeding, or electroplating  

**What We Offer**

* Full time contract up to 3 years (ASE (Accés al Sistema Espanyol de Ciència i Innovació) contract pursuant to Spanish Law 14/2011)
* Access to state-of-the-art microfabrication and characterization facilities
* A dynamic and interdisciplinary research environment
* Opportunities to work on high-impact projects bridging fundamental research and real-world applications
A family allowance may be granted to candidates with dependents, according to ICFO policies.  

**Equal Opportunity**

ICFO is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based solely on merit and potential, regardless of gender, nationality, or disability. ICFO fully endorses the European Charter for Researchers and Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers, ensuring a transparent and supportive recruitment process.

To apply, please submit your:

* resume,

contact information for 2 professional references.  

  
Applications should be submitted via the ICFOjobs platform http://jobs.icfo.eu.

The selection process is conducted in accordance with ICFO’s Open, Transparent and Merit-based Recruitment (OTM-R) Policy, ensuring equal opportunities, transparency, and fair treatment for all applicants. title: Senior Field Marketing Manager
description:

**Tendios**

At Tendios, we are building the intelligence layer for public procurement. Our platform helps companies identify and win public tenders, while helping public institutions improve procurement processes and tender management.

Tendios is at a turning point. Over the next three years we have the opportunity to grow from a local Catalan player into a global company, multiplying our revenue, our team and our customer base across many new countries. Events are where we meet our customers, build our brand and generate demand across the public procurement ecosystem. That is why field marketing is a key area at Tendios.

We are looking for an outstanding Senior Field Marketing Manager who will own our events strategy end to end, in Spain and internationally, and become one of the public faces of Tendios.

You will join the Marketing team, reporting directly to the Global Head of Marketing. This is an autonomous, high-ownership role at the intersection of brand, demand generation and public-sector relationships.

### **Your Mission**

Turn Tendios' events into a growth engine: build brand awareness, generate qualified pipeline and position Tendios as the reference in AI for public procurement, in Spain and in every new market we enter.

This role is not only about organising events. It is about owning the stage: designing memorable experiences, taking the microphone and building the relationships that open doors for Tendios.

### **Responsibilities**

**Events strategy and end-to-end management**

* Define and own the annual events calendar for Spain and international markets
* Manage every event end to end: concept, budget, organisers, vendors, logistics, stand production, onsite execution and follow-up
* Design and run Tendios' own events, from breakfasts and workshops to flagship forums
* Lead Tendios' event presence in new international markets

**Public speaking and brand representation**

* Act as a Tendios spokesperson: present, moderate panels and host our own events
* Identify and secure speaking slots and event sponsorships at key sector gatherings
* Represent Tendios in front of public-sector buyers, suppliers and the media

**Webinars**

* Own Tendios' webinar programme end to end: strategy, calendar, topics, speakers, promotion, delivery and lead follow-up
* Use webinars to reach new audiences in Spain and international markets
* Measure the impact of each webinar on registrations, attendance, leads and pipeline

**Strategic relationships for field**

* Manage relationships with event organisers, public entities, associations, chambers of commerce and speakers

**Internal collaboration**

* Work closely with Sales, Customer Success and Product so that every event serves commercial goals
* Equip the Sales team with the materials and plans they need before, during and after each event

We are looking for someone excellent, detail-oriented and passionate about events. Someone who feels at home both behind the scenes and on stage.

#### **Experience**

* 8+ years in event management, ideally in B2B or B2G
* Proven end-to-end management of events and webinars, in Spain and internationally
* Experience in public procurement: you understand how public tenders work and how the public sector buys
* Proven experience in public speaking.

SaaS, tech or GovTech experience is a strong plus.

* Excellent communication skills, written and spoken
* Great attention to detail: every event reflects the quality of our brand
* Autonomy and ownership: you set priorities, make decisions and deliver results
* Strong relationship-building skills
* Budget and vendor management
* Experience with HubSpot or similar CRM and event management tools

AI as a productivity ally

Tendios is at the beginning of its international journey, and field marketing will be decisive in it. title: Logistics Manager
description:
**About Carl Friedrik**

Carl Friedrik is a leading premium travel goods and luggage brand, renowned for our exquisite craftsmanship, innovative design, and unwavering commitment to quality. Our products are inspired by the art of travel, catering to discerning customers who seek both style and functionality. We travel differently, inspiring us to ‘Carry with Confidence’.

The Logistics Manager owns inbound logistics: getting our products from our factories to our warehouses in the UK, the EU and the US, on time and at the right cost. You will manage our freight forwarders day to day, liaise with supplier around the world and report on inbound lead times and costs. This role is vital to the success of the company, you will report to the Head of Operations and will work closely with the production teams and warehouses to ensure KPIs are consistently met.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and manage inbound shipments from our factories to our UK, EU and US warehouses, from collection to booked-in stock.
* Get quotes, book freight with our forwarders and choose the right mode for each shipment's timing and cost.
* Work with Supply Chain on production readiness, collection dates and container loads.
* Book delivery slots with our warehouses and make sure goods are received and booked in on time.
* Track every shipment and flag delays early to Supply Chain and Operations.
* Manage customs clearance, duty and import documentation, including HS classification, commercial invoices and packing lists.
* Report monthly on inbound lead times by route and forwarder: factory-ready to collection, transit, and arrival to booked-in stock.
* Find savings through tenders, renegotiations and better consolidation of shipments.

  

* 3+ years in inbound or international logistics, ideally in e-commerce, direct-to-consumer or retail, including managing freight forwarders.
* Hands-on experience with sea, air and road freight, incoterms and customs, especially UK–EU and US imports.
* Confidence negotiating with forwarders and holding them to quoted costs and transit times.
* Strong numbers skills: you can build a cost and lead time reports using spreadsheets.
* Strong organisational skills, with an ability to manage multiple tasks and work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills - you will liaise internally and externally across multiple departments.
* Curious and proactive - you enjoy digging into processes, spotting where things can be better, and following through on improvement.

title: Head of Global Events and Travel (100% REMOTE)
description:
The Head of Global Events & Travel leads the strategy, governance, and execution of our global events and corporate travel function. This role oversees three interconnected areas:

* **Flagship, VIP, High-Complexity & Client/client’s customers-Facing Events** (client and client’s customers events, executive dinners, and high-touch VIP gatherings);
* **Internal Meetings & Corporate Travel** (global gatherings, executive offsites, collaborators travel program); and
* **Dedicated Financial Control & Commercial Management**.

The Head is accountable for the full events and corporate travel portfolio, consolidated budgets, strategic supplier agreements, service standards, and duty-of-care governance. Serving both internal teams and external stakeholders (clients, prospects, and partners), the Head sets priorities, builds team capability, and manages major commercial decisions and C-level/client escalations. Financial oversight is supported by the Event & Travel Finance Lead in alignment with central Corporate FP&A.

A key initial priority is leading the implementation and transition to our enhanced travel operating model. Once established, the Head provides oversight through periodic performance reviews and exception management, delegating routine operations to the team and Travel Management Companies (TMCs).

**Responsibilities**

* **Function Leadership:** Lead and develop the Team. Recruit open roles, establish team cadence, and build capabilities across the function. Strategic resource planning across agencies, production vendors, and internal talent to execute both internal and client-facing events seamlessly.
* **Flagship, VIP & Client/client’s customers-Facing Events:** Execute on objectives, budgets, and brand standards set by C-Level leadership for 5,000-attendee conference, VIP executive receptions, and regional customer summits. Manage delivery through the internal Team, supported by event specialists and external agencies. Lead venue selection, production, security, contract negotiations, and attendee experience for both internal and external audiences.
* **Internal Meetings & Offsites:** Oversee the internal gathering strategy and delivery. Standardize playbooks for routine company meetings and regional leadership offsites.
* **Travel Operating Model Transition:** Lead the implementation of our approved global travel operating model, including RFPs and contracts for multi-region TMCs, unified policy and expense frameworks, approvals, reconciliation, and dual quoting. Coordinate phased migration corridor-by-corridor, validate vendor acceptance, protect service continuity, and establish an operational handover once stable.
* **Corporate Travel Oversight:** Own global travel strategy, master agreements, and major operational escalations. Oversee daily fulfillment, group flights, hotel blocks, rebooking, and high-touch support for executives, clients, and guest speakers managed by TMCs and the Travel & Logistics Coordinator.
* **Budget Accountability & Resource Stewardship:** Own the consolidated events and travel budget, as well as revenue/cost-recovery models for sponsored or client-facing events. Act as a steward of company resources, prioritizing expenditure against strategic business objectives, maximizing ROI on client events, identifying cost-saving opportunities, and escalating forecast overruns early with mitigation plans.
* **Financial Governance & Client Billing:** Work through the Team to manage annual budgets, rolling forecasts, vendor deposits, event ledgers, cross-charging/client billing, invoice reconciliation, and post-event financial reviews. Maintain strict approval thresholds, separation of duties, purchase orders, payment terms, and international VAT/GST recovery.

At ICON Strategic Solutions, you will work in a sponsor-dedicated model, supported by ICON’s global expertise.

Identify and encourage use of data-driven oversight tools and methods at the site, study & program level

description:
**¿Todo listo para tu nueva aventura?**

En blue banana creemos firmemente que las personas son el centro de nuestro desarrollo como marca.

Por ello, nuestro objetivo es atraer el mejor talento para seguir creciendo en este proyecto sin límites, donde trabajamos para empoderar a las nuevas generaciones a hacer de sus vidas una aventura. Nuestra misión nos invita a conectar con nuestro consumidor de una manera significativa, a través de la creación de contenido, de historias inspiradoras y de productos icónicos de alta calidad, responsables con el medioambiente.

¿Te identificas con nuestra pasión y propósito? Si es así, sigue leyendo y descubre cómo puedes ser parte de esta emocionante misión.

**Misión del puesto**  
Buscamos un perfil senior en marketing, fuerte en capacidad analitica, interpretación de  
datos y orientación a negocio, que contribuya a la toma de decisiones del área y reporte  
directamente al Head of MKT.  
Una persona capaz de analizar datos, conectar estrategia, activación y resultados  
comerciales.

Tus contribuciones a blue banana serán excepcionales si logras desarrollar las siguientes funciones:

**Análisis de negocio y marketing**

* Analizar de forma continua los resultados del negocio y acciones de marketing  
  (campañas 360) identificando KPIS para detectar desviaciones, oportunidades de  
  mejora y palancas de crecimiento.
* Proponer recomendaciones estratégicas basadas en datos, priorizando las  
  iniciativas de mayor impacto y optimizando la asignación de recursos y presupuesto.
* Evaluar la rentabilidad y eficacia de las inversiones y campañas de marketing,  
  analizando su contribución a las ventas, captación de clientes y recurrencia y la  
  construcción de marca.
* Reporting ejecutivo: Cuadro de mando semanal, informe mensual de marketing y  
  recaps de campañas clave del retail calendar a dirección y comité.
* Impulsar una cultura de medición, análisis y mejora continua dentro del área de  
  marketing.

**Estrategia, planificación y monitorización de marketing**

* Traducir los objetivos estratégicos en planes de marketing accionables (con  
  prioridades, calendario, presupuesto y KPIs definidos y monitorizados) para el  
  mercado de Iberia, España y Portugal, en coordinación con el resto del equipo de  
  Marketing.
* Preparar análisis, recomendaciones y propuestas estratégicas para apoyar la toma  
  de decisiones siguiendo el retail calendar y los hitos del mercado.
* Accionar planes de medios y campañas para adquisición de nuevas audiencias  
  siendo clave la generación de demanda y tráfico en el canal retail.
* Tener al cliente en el centro de todas las decisiones, identificando oportunidades de  
  crecimiento a partir del análisis del mercado y competencia, conocimiento de usuario  
  y prescriptor y tendencias del sector.
* Garantizar la coherencia entre las iniciativas de marca y las acciones comerciales a  
  nivel omnicanal y para los dos mercados.
* Liderazgo y ownership- junto con el equipo de CRM- de la estrategia de cliente  
  global (nuevos y fieles) monitorizando captación, recurrencia, estrategia de  
  fidelización (club Adventure Pass) con foco clave en la tienda física.
* Diseñar y potenciar campañas de marketing de performance y afiliación para  
  visibilizar la estrategia de producto omnicanal en ambos mercados y crear una  
  comunidad alineada con el brand equity.
* Dominio del uso de IA para aplicar a la toma de decisiones, transformación de ideas  
  y oportunidades en estrategias y campañas.
* Ownership del presupuesto y objetivos del area de mkt
* Liderazgo para visibilizar el impacto de MKT.

**Y… ¿que te hará triunfar con nosotros?**

* **Experiencia**: +6 años en marketing en empresas de moda, cosmética, belleza y/o retail (valorable experiencia en empresas internacionales).
* **Al menos +4 años de experiencia demostrable y real como Marketing Manager en**:
* Análisis de ventas.
* Conocimiento de cliente, hábitos de compra, CRM y loyalty.
* Planificación y gestión de campañas 360.
* Ownership de presupuesto.
* Consecución del plan de marketing y de los objetivos fijados, así como cumplimiento del presupuesto.
* **Conocimientos técnicos**:
* Dominio obligatorio de Shopify, Excel avanzado y PowerPoint.
* Uso de herramientas de IA para análisis, gestión y reporting.
* Valorable conocimiento de Smile/Klaviyo.
* Idiomas: español e inglés (hablado y escrito). Se valorarán otros idiomas, especialmente portugués.
* **Skills o competencias clave**:
* Pensamiento analítico y estratégico basado en datos.
* Orientación a resultados y visión de negocio.
* Capacidad de planificación y priorización.
* Capacidad de ejecución y seguimiento de KPIs.

Entrarás en un proyecto con un equipo equilibrado entre talento joven y experiencia sólida. Aquí hay profesionalidad, buen rollo y apoyo real. Queremos que te sientas acompañado desde el primer día y parte del equipo de verdad.

title: Senior Enterprise Systems Analyst
description:
**ABOUT US**

In more than ten countries around the world, The Knot Worldwide champions the power of celebration. Our global family of brands provide best-in-class products, services and content to take celebration planning from inspiration to action. At the core of our business is our industry-leading global online wedding Vendor Marketplace, connecting couples with local wedding professionals and a comprehensive suite of personalized wedding websites, planning tools, invitations, and registry services that make wedding planning easier for couples around the globe. Each year, we connect more than 4.5 million users with around 900,000 global small businesses through our Vendor Marketplace.

**LIFE AT TKWW**

At The Knot Worldwide, we believe in doing work that matters. Each year, we help millions of couples around the world celebrate life's most meaningful moments, while also helping hundreds of thousands of global small business owners get discovered and scale. Life here means working alongside a team that cares deeply, not just about the work you do, but about the life you live. We prioritize employee well-being and development through meaningful opportunities for growth, and we celebrate milestones and wins in a big way. After all, celebrations are what we do best.

**ABOUT THE ROLE AND OUR TEAM:**

The Knot is seeking a **Senior Enterprise Systems Analyst** to join our growing Enterprise Systems team. This role will touch various internal technology workstreams, but is heavily focused on Enterprise systems used by our accounting and finance teams including NetSuite, Salesforce, Zuora Revenue and Payment Processors. Your responsibilities will include working closely with our Global Accounting, Billing, and FP&A teams to understand their needs, evaluating current systems, identifying necessary configuration/customization, implementing system changes, and working closely with stakeholders to test and launch changes. You should be comfortable interacting with finance team members to achieve successful outcomes. You will serve as a point of contact for these teams when they have questions or need guidance working with these systems. You'll work inside of our Global Enterprise Team with Accounting, FP&A and Custom Development teams to ensure that our financial systems are being built & maintained in a sustainable, compliant, and successful manner. You'll also frequently work with other team members in the Global Enterprise Team to sync data into financial systems from Salesforce and other internal systems.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Works on multiple, moderate to high complex projects as a project team member and often leads the development of new system customizations and processes.
* Create and maintain Billing and Cash Application process mapping and scenario documentation.
* Work closely with Business Stakeholders and technical teams on the design and implementation of documented requirements.
* Assist the Finance team with various projects, tasks, and duties as needed, including supporting Finance and IT audit and data management requirements.

title: Measurement Specialist
description:
*Do you want to own the tracking that well-known Nordic brands use to decide where their marketing budget goes? And would you like to build it with server-side tagging, Consent Mode v2 and conversion APIs, from an office with a view of the beach in Barcelona?*

As a Measurement Specialist at s360, you'll make sure the data behind our clients' marketing decisions is correct. Most of your clients are Danish brands and retailers. You'll be the person they talk to when something breaks, and the person who builds it properly when it's time for something bigger. You'll work with a current measurement stack, including server-side Tag Manager, Enhanced Conversions and the Meta Conversions API, in an international team working across the Nordics and Spain.

**Make marketing data dependable**

Most of your time will go to hands-on delivery. Some tasks take an afternoon, like working out why a Meta purchase event is counting twice. Others run for weeks, like moving a client to server-side tagging with Consent Mode v2 in place. On smaller tasks you own the job from start to finish, including the conversation with the client. On larger projects a Denmark-based account lead scopes the work and owns the client relationship, and you're responsible for the build.

Your main responsibilities will be:

* **Troubleshooting:** Find and fix tracking issues across Google Ads, GA4, Meta and other ad platforms for Danish clients.
* **Implementation projects:** Build and configure GA4 and Google Tag Manager setups, client-side and server-side, including Consent Mode v2, Enhanced Conversions and conversion APIs.
* **dataLayer specifications:** Write dataLayer specifications for client developers and validate their implementation before go-live.
* **Quality assurance:** Test every setup before handover so it passes Quality Assurance checks without rework.
* **Documentation:** Document each implementation so clients and colleagues can take it over without friction.
* **Client contact:** Answer client questions directly on the work you own, and keep the Danish Account lead updated on anything that affects the relationship.

**Join our Measurement team in Barcelona**

You will become part of a Measurement team spread across Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland, and Spain. Based at Norrsken House Barcelona, you will sit with colleagues who support clients in Denmark, Sweden, and Norway while working closely with the wider international team. You'll report to the Group Head of Measurement, who works from the same office. English is our working language, if you speak a Nordic language as well, that’s a big plus.

**Bring measurement depth and a practical mindset**

We are looking for a hands-on specialist who can take ownership of client tasks, work carefully through technical problems, and communicate clearly when the answer is not obvious. You should be comfortable working independently while asking for input early, sharing useful patterns, and acting on feedback.

You'll probably be a good fit if you recognise the following about yourself:

* **Google Tag Manager:** Two or more years of hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager for the web, including tags, triggers, variables, custom templates and preview-mode debugging.
* **JavaScript and dataLayer:** Enough JavaScript to work confidently with the dataLayer and troubleshoot implementation issues.
* **GA4 implementation:** Solid experience configuring GA4, including ecommerce events, custom dimensions and validation in DebugView.
* **Server-side tagging:** Experience setting up and maintaining server-side Google Tag Manager, for example on Stape or Google Cloud.
* **Ad platform tracking:** Experience with Google Ads and Meta conversion tracking, including Enhanced Conversions and the Meta Conversions API.
* **Consent and privacy:** Practical knowledge of Consent Mode v2 and CMP integrations such as Cookiebot or Cookie Information.
* **Structured way of working:** Strong documentation habits and the discipline to test and challenge setups before signing off.
* **Communication and languages:** Strong written and spoken English, with Danish or another Nordic language as a plus.

**What it’s like working at s360**

At s360, you will be part of a Marketing and AI consultancy, working alongside more than 330 skilled colleagues across 10 offices in 8 countries. While our shared mission is to help brands and retailers grow, we are equally committed to fostering a strong culture, defined by collaboration, drive, and continuous development. We believe that our culture and ways of working are key to delivering long-term, meaningful results.

As a part of our team, you can look forward to:

* **Skilled colleagues:** Collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry and be part of an ambitious team with deep expertise across all key digital disciplines.
* **Top-tier clients:** Work with some of the biggest brands in the world on solving their most complex and interesting commercial problems.
* **Growth journey:** Join one of the fastest-growing marketing and AI consultancies in Europe with the ambition of becoming the best in the world.
* **International environment:** With 10 offices across 8 countries, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with people from diverse cultures around the world.
* **Career acceleration:** Get individual career plans to influence your own professional path and contribute to shaping the company’s future.
* **Continuous development:** A learning culture where people strive to become 1% better every day, supported by advanced training and knowledge sharing.

**We look forward to hearing from you!**

Does this sound like the right fit for you? Do you have any questions? Then don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Carlos Pinto, Senior Measurement Manager, cpd@s360digital.com.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and hire as soon as the right candidate is found, so please send your CV and application as soon as possible. All inquiries are treated confidentially.

The **Medical Director** at WEP Clinical serves as the primary medical and scientific expert for clinical trial protocols and Expanded Access Programs (EAPs), playing a crucial role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and successful execution of studies. As the protocol expert, the Medical Director is responsible for guiding investigators and internal/external teams in implementing and adhering to the study protocol. * Participate in investigator discussions during site selection to assess suitability and experience for the study or program.

Senior eCommerce Content Strategist
description:
**About Us**  
Since 2003, Luzern eCommerce has been helping leading global brands grow their online business. We partner with brands including Panasonic, Reebok, Stokke, KIKO, Next, Twining's, Canon, Bondi Sands and Philips, helping them accelerate growth and deliver exceptional customer experiences across major marketplaces including Amazon and Zalando, branded webstores and social platforms.

Backed by significant investment, Luzern is an international, technology-led eCommerce business with anambitious growth strategy. Our AI-enabled Channel Optimizer platform, combined with our eCommerce expertise, helps brands manage and grow their presence across increasingly complex digital channels.  
As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for talented people who enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to play an active role in the next stage of Luzern's development.

The Senior eCommerce Content Strategist owns content strategy and execution across Amazon and the wider commerce ecosystem for Luzern's enterprise brand clients. Amazon is the primary focus — listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related content — but the role is deliberately platform-agnostic in outlook, extending strategy and content guidance to other marketplaces, retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando,Otto) and D2C.

The role is audit-led: content strategy is built from a structured read of customer and platform signals — reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers put to AI assistants and platform agents — combined with a quality assessment of current content (using a framework such as IDQ or equivalent) against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements. Strategy, messaging and content requirements follow from that evidence base, rather than from assumption.

A defining part of the role is thinking beyond traditional platform search: strategies must consider how content needs to be structured and prepared to be discovered and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g. Amazon's Rufus), alongside conventional marketplace and retailer search algorithms.

The role sits as the senior content specialist within a small delivery pod, working alongside an SEO Executive and Designers. It carries direct client-facing responsibility: estimating, briefing, managing feedback and contributing to proposals and is responsible for reviewing the pod's output before it reaches the client. It does not carry resourcing, project management or formal line management responsibility.

**Tasks**
---------

**What You’ll Be Doing**

**Content Audits & Quality Assessment**  

* Signal analysis: analyse customer reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers and AI agents put to platforms (e.g. Rufus prompts), to understand what content needs to do and where current content falls short.
* Quality benchmarking — review current platform content and score it against a content quality framework (e.g. IDQ or equivalent), benchmarking against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements.
* Findings to action — translate audit findings into a clear, prioritised view of content requirements that feeds directly into strategy.

**Content Strategy Development**  

* Amazon content ownership- develop and own content strategy and execution for listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related Amazon content, as the role's primary focus.
* Cross-platform extension — extend strategy and content recommendations to other marketplaces,retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C storefronts, adapting to each platform's content rules, algorithm and customer behaviour.
* Strategic framework - from audit findings, develop comms objectives, key messages and a messaging hierarchy for each client or category.
* Content requirements - define the content requirements, imagery and copy needed to deliverthe strategy, and the frameworks/guidelines the team and client can act on.
* Wireframes & mock-ups - develop A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups in collaborationwith the Designer, turning strategy into an executable creative direction.

**AI & Agentic Discoverability**  

* AI-ready content — build content strategies that account for how product and brand content is read, ranked and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g. ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g Rufus), alongside traditional search.
* Point of view — keep Luzern's thinking on AI/agentic discoverability current, and translate emerging platform and LLM behaviour into practical, sellable content recommendations.
* Alignment with SEO — partner with the SEO Executive so keyword and search strategy and content structure are aligned across traditional and AI-mediated discovery.

**Testing & Performance Monitoring**  

* A/B testing — recommend and run A/B tests (e.g. on A+ Content, Brand Store, imagery and messaging) to determine the most effective executional approach, rather than relying on opinion or precedent.
* Monitoring set-up - set up monitoring using Compass (or equivalent) to measure content effectiveness and implementation.
* Reporting on impact — track and report on content performance against strategy objectives, feeding learnings back into future audits and strategy.

**Creative Briefing & Review**  

* Strategic foundation - develop the strategy and messaging that underpins paid social, display and

marketplace advertising content.  

* Creative briefs - write and own briefs for Designers producing static and video ad assets, translating strategy into clear creative direction.
* Creative review - review creative output against the brief, brand guidelines and platform requirements before client delivery.

**Client Management**  

* Client-facing delivery - present content strategy, recommendations and audit findings directly to client stakeholders.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**What we're building**
=======================

We're empowering small teams with technology that makes it easier to market and grow businesses. Our current focus is to help consumer brands shift from "workflow automation" to "agent management" within their marketing operations. Shadow is the AI coordination layer — providing shared AI memory, centralized agent control, and model orchestration for marketing teams.

**Why join Shadow?**
====================

* **Product Ownership** You'll ship production code daily and help steer key product and technical decisions.
* **Shape the Engineering Culture** You'll influence how we work—tools, processes, standards, and hiring.
* **Work with Challenger Consumer Brands** Talk directly to customers (CEOs, CMOs, VP's) of fast-growing consumer brands—some doing $80M–$500M in revenue.

**The agency behind the product**
=================================

Shadow is built alongside Darkroom — a performance marketing agency that's been operating for 10 years, employs 100+ people, runs 100+ clients at a time, and has worked with over 1,000 consumer brands. The agency is both our proving ground and our first user, which means the data you build with is real marketing data at real volume from day one — not a synthetic demo.

**This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).**

**The role**
============

You’ll own features end-to-end at Shadow, from the first conversation with a user to the polished screen in production. You’ll design in Figma and in code, and ship it yourself.  
You’ll work forward-deployed. You’ll sit with the subject-matter experts who use Shadow every day, like media buyers, strategists and creatives, to learn how they actually work and where they get stuck. Then you’ll turn what you learn into features that fix it.  
You’ll also keep Shadow feeling like one product. As new features land, you’ll make sure every screen, from dashboards to agent conversations, follows the same system and meets the same bar.

**Core Tech & Tools**

* **Languages & Frameworks:** Python, Node.js, React (TypeScript)
* **Datastore:** PostgreSQL
* **Cloud & Infra:** Google Cloud Platform, Airflow, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes
* **ML/AI:** LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering

**What you'll do**
==================

* Own features end-to-end: find the problem, shape the solution, then design, build and ship it.
* Embed with subject-matter experts to learn their workflows and challenges firsthand.
* Turn what you learn into product: agent conversations, performance and creative dashboards, the marketing calendar, and whatever comes next.
* Own UI/UX consistency across the whole app. Keep the design system current in Figma and React, and hold every new screen to it.
* Sweat the details, including type, spacing, motion, loading and empty states.
* Prototype fast, in code, in Figma or with AI tools, and put ideas in front of experts within days.
* Invent interaction patterns for agentic work. That means streaming answers, showing the agent’s reasoning, approving changes before they touch a live ad account, and admitting when data is missing.
* Turn dense, multi-channel data into screens a marketer can read in seconds.
* Bring the new Shadow brand into the product, working with our brand partners.

**Must haves**
==============

* Shipped product UI you’re proud of, plus a portfolio or live work that shows both the design and the code.
* Strong React, TypeScript and CSS (Tailwind a plus). You can own a frontend codebase, not just individual components.
* Real visual and interaction design skill: typography, layout, color, motion and micro-interactions.
* Curiosity about how other people work. You can spend a day with a media buyer and come back with the real problem, not just a feature request.
* A systems mindset. You notice when two screens solve the same problem differently, and you fix it.
* Equal comfort in Figma and in your editor, and the judgment to know when to skip Figma.
* Taste for data-dense interfaces. Your dashboards, tables and charts stay calm under a lot of information.
* Daily use of AI tools like Cursor or Claude Code, with opinions on how AI products should feel.
* Comfort with ambiguity. You’d rather ship and learn than polish in private.
* Clear writing. You can explain the why behind a design to engineers, experts and non-designers.
* Most people who fit this have 5+ years across design and some experience with frontend engineering.

**Nice to haves**
=================

* Forward-deployed, solutions or customer-facing work, or research with expert users.
* You’ve built a design system that other engineers rely on.
* Data visualization work in D3, Visx, Recharts or hand-rolled SVG.
* Motion work, such as spring animation or Framer Motion.
* Experience with LLM APIs, streaming interfaces or agent products.
* Time spent around marketing, ecommerce or analytics tools, or running ads yourself.

**What we offer**
=================

* **Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every employee exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
-------------------------------

We are an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Head of Marketing
description:
Head of Marketing

Town Web · HeyGov  
Remote · Full-time contractor

**The Quick Version**

Have you ever seen a company create their own National Holiday as part of its marketing efforts?

We did!

Speaking of silly stuff, we even wrote and produced our own comedic commercial about the real pains that our customers have, and it helped make one of our tools the fastest growing AI tool in the industry!

Ultimately we want our marketing to be funny, human, and memorable, because honestly a lot of the stuff out there in the government industry (which is where we compete) is boring.

Now we're looking for someone exceptionally creative to lead our marketing department — a person with the freedom to take big creative swings and the resources to execute their own.

Our brands — Town Web, HeyGov, and ClerkMinutes — form a suite of tools built specifically for municipal clerks, and each one is crafted to be exceptional at its job. If you're a highly effective, exceptional marketing professional, we'd love for you to apply. Below are more details about who we are and what we're trying to achieve.

Here's a video to tell you more about this role!

**The details**

Who we are

We're a small, bootstrapped company approaching $3M in ARR, competing against large, private-equity-owned firms with far deeper pockets. That's why our marketing has to be exceptional on two fronts at once: creative work that is unique and memorable, and follow-through to match it — multi-channel campaigns, disciplined measurement, and sophisticated execution that turns attention into pipeline.

Our customers are municipal clerks at cities, counties, and municipalities of all sizes. They are busy, under-resourced, deeply practical, and they talk to each other (which as you can guess is why we are emphasising the need to have exceptional marketing!)

We build focused products for the clerk specifically, designed to work together as a suite. ClerkMinutes became one of the most widely adopted tools in its category largely on the strength of marketing that looked like nothing else in this space, and your job is to push that further across the whole portfolio. We run on EOS, and the marketing department's cadence — L10s, quarterly Rocks, scorecards — will be yours to run.

What you'll own

* Strategy and positioning across the portfolio, and the department's EOS operating cadence
* Demand and revenue — building a qualified pipeline for Sales through targeted campaigns and similar initiatives. This is how success is measured.
* Full-channel execution — conferences, webinars, direct mail, PR, and outbound alongside digital and paid. Clerks trust people who show up in person, so you will too.
* Lifecycle marketing — from first touch through trial to customer, along with the tech, tracking, and attribution behind it
* The quality bar — you're the final day-to-day reviewer on copy, design, campaigns, and launches
* Go-to-market with Product and Sales — new product launches and targeted campaigns that get us early beta testers, help build awareness for product pilots, and than formal product releases.

Who does well here

Isn’t it clear we’re looking for somebody extremely creative and ambitious!? Are you “THE ONE?”

We’re looking for a creative strategist and an enthusiastic builder who can lead the team from the front line. Think of a special-forces team leader: they plan the mission, and when it's time to move, they're also the first one through the door. That's the posture this role needs — you set the strategy, and then you're in the weeds executing it right alongside the team.

And there is a team. You'll work directly with our copywriters, internal product managers, the sales team, and the people who handle data connection and attribution through Salesforce and our other marketing tools. You'll have a team around you, but want to be clear: we’re not looking for a “manager of managers”.

AI tools like Claude or Codex are part of your daily workflow, and you rely on them to get competent quickly in unfamiliar territory, whether that's GEO, GA4, or something we haven't thought of yet. You also know how to work with a highly creative founder: turning a lot of ideas into focused priorities, pushing back when something won't work, and making sure the good ones actually ship.

This role suits someone who's comfortable working without a finished playbook, and who would rather be in the work than above it.

What we need to see

* Exceptional Enthusiasm
* Extremely Creative Energy
* You've led a marketing function and been accountable for its results
* You've made a traditional or crowded category stand out with ideas of your own
* AI is central to how you work, and you're comfortable enough with code to build or fix small things yourself
* Real paid acquisition experience across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and Bing, and you can run SEO and GEO by directing AI tools well
* Hands-on experience with direct mail, paid ads, conferences, PR, or other high-attention channels, and you're happy traveling to meet clerks and work conferences alongside Sales
* B2B SaaS background, and you've managed employees, contractors, and agencies

Nice to have: GovTech or public-sector experience, marketing more than one product at a time, and building measurement where little existed. EOS familiarity helps too!

How to apply

* Complete the Workable Form, and make sure to include your resume.
* There will questions to answer. Please make sure you answer them- we read these!

  
**Requirements**  
  
**IMPORTANT**

* Only applications submitted through the proper channel, which is Workable, will be processed.
* Taking the CultureIndex Survey is a requirement, we will not respond to any applications submitted without this.

* Analyze landing page performance and identify optimization opportunities.

* Review campaign performance and translate data into actionable insights.

We're looking for someone who enjoys experimenting, learning, and continuously improving existing processes.

  
Requirements:  
  

**Essential**

* 5+ years of experience in Performance Marketing, CRO, Digital Marketing, or Growth Marketing.
* Strong understanding of customer acquisition funnels and landing page optimization.
* Experience planning and evaluating A/B tests.
* Ability to interpret marketing data and make data-driven decisions.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams.
* Excellent project management and organizational skills.
* Exceptional communication skills.
* Proficient English language skills.
* Experience with AI tools for marketing research and automation.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in Home Improvement or Lead Generation industries.
* Experience working with Meta, Google Ads, Native Advertising, or YouTube.
* Knowledge of UX principles and conversion optimization.
* Familiarity with Tableau, GA4, Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, or similar analytics tools.

**﻿****Why do we deserve your attention?**

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

**Remote Work**

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

**Paid Time Off**

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

**Ongoing Learning**

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

**Home Office**

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

**Physical Well-Being**

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

description:
Are you an experienced marketing project manager who wants to join multicultural team? We are looking for a **Marketing Project Lead** who can grow alongside the project and reach new heights. You’ll be part of a creative and friendly team in a people-oriented environment that values autonomy, results-driven thinking, and achieving business goals.  
  
**Brandbutter** is part of **CENTRO** is a fully remote creative marketing agency partnering with ambitious brands to build awareness, relevance, and growth in fast-moving markets. We work across strategy, content, campaigns, and events, operating as an embedded partner rather than a task-based service provider.

**About the role**  
You’ll lead one of our two marketing cells, covering several brands across B2B fintech, adtech and creator programs. You’ll own the marketing vision and roadmap for these brands and lead a team of designers and social media managers to deliver it.

This is a player-coach role, not a pure management one. You’ll set direction and lead the team, but you’ll also spend a large share of your time doing the work yourself: writing the strategy, building campaigns, drafting copy, setting up ads and building AI workflows. You’ll report to the Director of Marketing.  
  
**What you’ll do:**

* **Set the vision.** Define the marketing strategy for each brand in your cell, grounded in business goals, customer insight and data.
* **Build and run the roadmap.** Turn quarterly OKRs into clear plans with priorities, owners and timelines, and make sure they ship.
* **Execute hands-on.** Write briefs, copy and campaign plans. Launch and optimise paid campaigns. Build landing pages and reports. Produce first versions yourself instead of waiting on others.
* **Lead and grow the team.** Coach designers and social media managers, delegate with clarity, give direct feedback and help people grow.
* **Make AI the default.** Identify where AI and automation can speed up research, content production, reporting and campaign operations, build those workflows yourself and teach the team to use them.
* **Own the numbers.** Track pipeline, lead quality, CPL, ROAS and engagement, and change course when something isn’t working.
* **Work across the business.** Partner with sales, product, tech and leadership, and present plans and results clearly and concisely.

  
**What you bring:**

* 7+ years in marketing, including at least 3 years leading a team. You can name people who grew under you.
* A doer’s track record: you’ve personally written, built, launched and optimised campaigns, not only managed people who did.
* Experience building marketing strategies and roadmaps from scratch, ideally across more than one brand or audience.

**What we offer**

* **Competitive salary** that reflects your skills and experience.
* **Remote flexibility:** work from anywhere, with a team that values balance and results.
* **Autonomy and ownership:** no bureaucracy or micromanagement, just room to take initiative and own your work.
* **Growth and development:** educational programs and support for your professional development.
* **Team events:** team-building activities and opportunities to attend industry events.
* **Time off:** paid holidays, vacation, personal days and sick leave.
