title: Director de Software Delivery

Buscamos un **Director de Software Delivery**

**Perfil buscado**

* Más de 12 años en ingeniería y entrega de software, de los cuales al menos 5 en dirección de delivery, DevOps o plataforma.
* Experiencia implantando CI/CD, release management y metodología de SDLC en organizaciones grandes y con múltiples proveedores.
* Experiencia en gobierno de APIs y conocimiento práctico de MCP y del desarrollo asistido por IA.
* Perfil con base técnica sólida, con credibilidad ante los equipos y capacidad para exigir estándares a los proveedores. No se busca un perfil exclusivamente metodológico o de agile coach.

**Encaje en la organización**

Una de sus funciones es mediar entre Run y Change y gobernar un calendario unificado de releases para ambos.

Su eficacia depende sobre todo de las áreas que entregan y operan el software fuera del área del CTO.

**Fuera del área del CTO**

* Dominios de producto. Son el principal interlocutor. Aplican la metodología en sus proyectos, sean internos o externalizados, y la exigen a sus proveedores. Software Delivery les da un proceso claro y les acompaña en su adopción.
* PMO. Alinea la planificación y el seguimiento de proyectos con la metodología y con el calendario de releases.
* SRE. Define con Software Delivery los criterios de paso a producción, la observabilidad y el rollback, y aporta las métricas de fallo de cambios y tiempo de recuperación.
* Infraestructura. Provee los entornos y la infraestructura sobre los que se ejecutan los pipelines y los entornos no productivos.
* Soporte. Recibe cada release con la comunicación y el traspaso a Run adecuados, y aporta las incidencias posteriores a cada subida como indicador de calidad.
* IT4IT. Provee y opera las herramientas del ciclo de vida (requisitos, repositorios, CI/CD, gestión de servicios), conforme a los estándares definidos por Software Delivery.

**Dentro del área del CTO**

* Arquitectura y UX. Definen sus estándares; Software Delivery garantiza que intervienen en cada proyecto mediante puntos de control obligatorios.
* QA. Define la estrategia de pruebas y su automatización; Software Delivery la integra como gate en la plataforma CI/CD y en el flujo entre entornos.
* IA. Construye el framework de desarrollo agéntico; Software Delivery lo industrializa dentro del SDLC.
* Ciberseguridad. Valida los controles de seguridad de los pipelines, las APIs y los servidores MCP.

The **Head of Information Security Architecture** (m/f/d) defines how security is embedded across Liebherr's IT, OT, cloud, data, digital products and emerging technology landscape. The role owns the information security architecture strategy, target state, principles and governance, translates business risks and regulatory obligations into scalable architectural direction, and drives Security by Design from idea through operation. **Creating passion: your responsibilities**
-------------------------------------------

Principles, standards and reference architectures:

* Define, maintain and govern information security architecture principles, standards, patterns, reference architectures and reusable blueprints.
* Provide integrated architectural direction across identity and access, cloud, network and Zero Trust, infrastructure, endpoint, data protection, security monitoring, OT and Product Security.
* Contribute to the information security architecture strategy and roadmap, aligning security architecture with business and CIS priorities.

* Define and report meaningful KPIs and KRIs covering standards adoption, review outcomes, exceptions, technical debt, Security-by-Design effectiveness and target-state maturity.

**Contributing your strengths: your qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Proven ability to establish Security by Design, architecture governance, standards and target-state architectures.
* Strong leadership and ability to translate business, risk and regulatory requirements into clear architecture decisions and guardrails.

description:
**About Us**

Integrity360 is a leading independent cybersecurity and PCI specialist operating across Europe, Africa, the Caribbean, and North America. The company has office locations in Ireland, the UK, Bulgaria, Italy, Sweden, Spain, Lithuania, Ukraine, Africa, the Caribbean, and Canada, supported by eight Security Operations Centres (SOCs) located in Dublin, Sofia, Madrid, Stockholm, Paris, Rome, Johannesburg and Cape Town.

With over 900 employees, including more than 600 dedicated cybersecurity professionals, Integrity360 delivers a full suite of professional, support, and managed security services. These span the complete cyber risk lifecycle, from identification and prevention to detection, response, and recovery. Integrity360 supports over 3000 mid-market and enterprise organisations across sectors including financial services, insurance, government, healthcare, retail, telecommunications, and utilities.

At Integrity360, people come first. We invest heavily in learning, development and progression, fostering a dynamic culture where innovation, collaboration and continuous growth are at the heart of what we do. If you're ready to take your cyber security career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you.

**Job Role / Responsibilities**

As a Microsoft Security Engineer, you will be responsible for onboarding clients to our managed security service, with Microsoft Sentinel at the centre of the solution. You will configure and integrate Sentinel environments, onboard and validate log sources, and prepare each deployment for effective monitoring and operational handover to the Security Operations Centre.

Your primary focus will be the technical delivery of new Microsoft Sentinel onboardings. This includes workspace and connector configuration, data collection design, log-source integration, ingestion filtering, validation, detection tuning and the production of high-level design and implementation documentation. You will work closely with clients, architects and SOC teams to ensure each deployment is supportable, secure and aligned with the contracted service scope.

The role also requires hands-on experience, or a clear ability to develop quickly, in onboarding Microsoft Defender XDR workloads such as Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps. You will help establish the integrations, policies and operational workflows required to provide joined-up detection and response across the Microsoft security ecosystem.

This is a client-facing engineering role within Professional Services, reporting to the Head of Cloud Security & Microsoft Security Services. You will manage assigned onboarding activities from discovery and design through implementation, testing, documentation and handover. You will be supported by an experienced team and have access to training and certification opportunities across Microsoft security technologies.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Deliver end-to-end onboarding of client Microsoft Sentinel environments into the MSSP service.
* Configure Sentinel workspaces, content solutions, data connectors, analytics rules, automation rules, watchlists, workbooks and related components in accordance with approved designs and service standards.
* Run technical discovery sessions to identify log sources, connectivity requirements, data volumes, retention needs, dependencies and onboarding priorities.
* Onboard Microsoft, third-party, cloud, network, identity and application log sources using supported collection methods, including Azure Monitor Agent, Data Collection Rules, APIs, syslog, CEF and custom connectors where appropriate.
* Design and implement data filtering and transformation to improve signal quality, control ingestion costs and ensure the service receives the telemetry required for monitoring and detection.
* Validate data ingestion, parsing, field mapping, timestamps, health and coverage, and troubleshoot issues across source systems, collectors, networks and Azure services.
* Tune analytics rules, alert logic and incident generation in collaboration with SOC and detection engineering teams to reduce unnecessary noise while maintaining appropriate coverage.
* Onboard and integrate Microsoft Defender XDR workloads, including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
* Produce accurate high-level designs, implementation plans, configuration records, test evidence, operational runbooks and handover documentation.
* Coordinate with clients, project managers, architects, SOC analysts and service teams to manage dependencies, risks, actions and readiness for service transition.
* Apply repeatable engineering standards, peer review and change control, and contribute improvements to onboarding templates, technical patterns and internal procedures.
* Support troubleshooting and remediation during onboarding and early-life support, escalating product or service dependencies where required.
* Undertake occasional travel where required to support client delivery.

**Essential**

  

* Hands-on experience deploying, configuring or supporting Microsoft Sentinel in production or customer environments.
* Practical knowledge of Sentinel data connectors, Log Analytics workspaces, Azure Monitor Agent, Data Collection Rules, syslog and CEF collection patterns.
* Strong Kusto Query Language skills for data validation, troubleshooting, investigation and detection tuning.
* Experience onboarding and troubleshooting log sources across Microsoft 365, Azure, endpoints, identity, network, security and third-party platforms.
* Understanding of ingestion filtering, data transformation, parsing, normalisation, retention and the cost implications of security telemetry.
* Experience creating clear technical designs and delivery documentation, including HLDs, implementation plans, test records and operational handover materials.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender XDR and the integration of its workloads with Microsoft Sentinel.
* Sound understanding of SIEM operations, detection engineering principles, incident workflows and the requirements of a managed security service.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across Azure, APIs, identity, networking and data collection components.
* Confident written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work directly with technical and non-technical client stakeholders.
* Ability to manage assigned work independently while collaborating effectively with project, architecture, SOC and service teams.

**Desired**

  

* Experience working for an MSSP, MDR provider, Security Operations Centre or security-focused professional services team.
* Development of custom log parsers, KQL functions, ASIM-compatible content or other normalisation patterns for non-standard data sources.
* Experience with DevOps pipelines and source control for Microsoft Sentinel content, configuration and deployment.
* Practical knowledge of detection as code, including versioning, testing, peer review and controlled promotion of analytics content between environments.
* Experience with infrastructure as code and automation using technologies such as Bicep, ARM templates, Terraform, PowerShell, Azure CLI, Logic Apps or APIs.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Sentinel repositories, content management and repeatable multi-customer deployment patterns.
* Experience integrating Microsoft security services across tenants, subscriptions or delegated administration models such as Azure Lighthouse.
* Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and its application to detection coverage and use-case mapping.

**Desired Qualifications**

  

* Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200).
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500/SC-500).
* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100).
* Relevant Microsoft Applied Skills covering Sentinel, Defender XDR, security operations or automation.
* Other relevant security or cloud certifications are beneficial but not essential.

title: Enterprise Architect – Banking
description:
**Company Description**

**Company Description**

**Talan – Positive Innovation**

Talan is an international consulting group specializing in innovation and business transformation through technology. With over 7,200 consultants in 21 countries and a turnover of €850M, we are committed to delivering impactful, future-ready solutions.

**Talan at a Glance**

Headquartered in Paris and operating globally, Talan combines technology, innovation, and empowerment to deliver measurable results for our clients. Over the past 22 years, we’ve built a strong presence in the IT and consulting landscape, and we’re on track to reach €1 billion in revenue this year.

**Our Core Areas of Expertise**

* **Data & Technologies:** We design and implement large-scale, end-to-end architecture and data solutions, including data integration, data science, visualization, Big Data, AI, and Generative AI.
* **Cloud & Application Services:** We integrate leading platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, Microsoft, AWS, and IBM Maximo, helping clients transition to the cloud and improve operational efficiency.
* **Management & Innovation Consulting:** We lead business and digital transformation initiatives through project and change management best practices (PM, PMO, Agile, Scrum, Product Ownership), and support domains such as Supply Chain, Cybersecurity, and ESG/Low-Carbon strategies.

**We work with major global clients across diverse sectors, including Transport & Logistics, Financial Services, Energy & Utilities, Retail, and Media & Telecommunications.**

 **Job Description**

**About the role**

We are looking for an experienced **Enterprise Architect** to join a strategic architecture and transformation initiative within **Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB)**.

In this role, you will work closely with senior technology and business stakeholders to define target architectures, assess complex technology landscapes, and drive strategic decisions around applications, platforms, data, integration and modernization.

This is a **hands-on architecture role**. We are looking for someone who can analyse complex environments, challenge existing approaches, develop target-state options and turn architectural decisions into clear, actionable recommendations.

**What will you do?**

* Define **decision-ready reference and target architectures** for priority CIB capabilities, including capability decomposition, target building blocks, architecture principles, data and integration patterns, and transition considerations.
* Work closely with **CIOs, Domain Technology Heads and senior business stakeholders**, challenging existing architectures, inherited constraints, local variations and investment assumptions.
* Analyse current application and platform landscapes to identify **duplication, fragmentation, obsolescence, dependencies, risks and opportunities for consolidation**.
* Translate architecture decisions into clear application-level recommendations, such as **adopt, consolidate, migrate, selectively invest, contain or retire**, including dependencies and transition sequencing.
* Assess **buy, build and reuse** alternatives, evaluating market maturity, comparable CIB adoption, integration fit, vendor lock-in and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).
* Prepare and lead **architecture decision forums and domain working groups**, presenting options, trade-offs, recommendations, required decisions and open dependencies.
* Assess **EUCs (End User Computing) and AI-enabled local solutions** within the target architecture, defining appropriate classification, controls, ownership and transition paths.
* Translate architecture decisions into **fundable initiatives**, contributing to preliminary business cases, expected benefits, complexity assessments, risks and investment planning.
* Collaborate with global and cross-domain teams to ensure alignment between strategic architecture and business transformation objectives.

  
**Qualifications**

**What are we looking for?**

**Mandatory requirements:**

* **8+ years of professional experience** in technology architecture, enterprise architecture or technology transformation.
* **At least 3 years of relevant experience in CIB / Wholesale Banking**. Experience in this sector is mandatory.
* Proven experience defining **reference architectures, target architectures and/or transition states** in complex technology environments.
* Experience in at least one of the following areas:
  + Application landscape rationalization
  + Platform consolidation
  + Technology modernization
* Strong understanding of current-to-target assessments and their implications across areas such as:
  + Applications
  + Data
  + Integration
  + Cloud
  + Resilience
  + Cybersecurity
* Ability to engage with **senior technology and business stakeholders**, constructively challenge existing approaches and clearly communicate architectural recommendations.
* **English: minimum B2 level, ideally C1**, with professional fluency in both written and spoken English. You will be required to prepare and present recommendations, lead meetings and collaborate with global stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree in **Engineering, Computer Science or a related field**.

**Nice to have**

* Strong knowledge of a major **CIB domain or transversal technology platform**.
* Experience leading **global or cross-domain transformation initiatives**.
* Experience assessing **buy / build / reuse** alternatives, market solutions and TCO.
* Experience working with **large-scale application portfolios** and producing decision-ready architecture materials.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in **Finance, Technology Management or a related field**.

  
**Additional Information**

**What do we offer you?**

* Full-time and permanent employment contract.
* Hybrid role based in Madrid.
* Professional growth possibilities & learning opportunities
* Possibility to join a multicultural team & work in the international environment
* Variety of benefits to support your physical, emotional and financial wellbeing: private medical insurance, life insurance, lunch and transport card as part of the flexible remuneration pack, and online language classes
* Smart Office Pack

**If you have read this far and you are looking forward to joining this challenge, do not hesitate to apply... we would be delighted to meet you!**

title: Lead Motion & Graphic Designer
description:
**TripleTen**
is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.
  
  
As a Lead Motion & Graphic Designer in the Curriculum team, you’ll turn complex tech concepts into clear visual and interactive learning experiences, and lead the team that makes them. About 80% of your time goes to hands-on design, motion, video, and interactive work; the other 20% to team leadership. Curriculum visuals help students understand and remember a concept, so we favor clarity, calm pacing, and accurate diagrams over flashy effects.
  
  
What you will do:
  
  

* Design learning visuals. Create graphics, animations, motion pieces, and explainer videos with Learning Experience Designers, from concept and storyboard to final edit.
* Set the quality bar. Own visual and motion standards for curriculum content: guidelines, templates, and reusable asset libraries.
* Lead the team. Run critiques, weekly planning, and retros; mentor designers with regular, actionable feedback; improve intake, reviews, and handoffs.
* Speed up production. Partner with product, design, and engineering on shared libraries, AI-assisted workflows, and automation of repetitive work.
* Prototype interactive formats. Design clickable diagrams, simple simulations, and step-by-step visual explainers for our learning platform.
* Finish video. Edit and enhance video content, adding simple visual effects and sound design.
* Experiment with new formats. Test new video and interactive formats, using Claude Design and Claude Code to prototype faster.

Requirements:
  
  
**Must have**

* 4+ years in motion and graphic design. A portfolio showing motion, graphic design, and visual storytelling, built in After Effects, Premiere Pro, and Figma.
* Design leadership. Experience leading or mentoring designers, or owning design standards and processes for a team.
* English at B2 or higher. Confident written and spoken English for daily work in a remote, cross-functional team.

**Nice to have**

* Interactive and UX work. Interactive pieces in your portfolio, and a grasp of how people read, scan, and interact with learning materials.
* AI creative tools. Hands-on use of Claude Design, Claude Code, or AI agents in Figma to prototype.
* Ed-tech and languages. Experience in ed-tech, e-learning, or instructional design; Spanish or Portuguese.

What we can offer you:
  
  

* Ownership. Real decision-making power in your area: we trust your expertise and don’t micromanage.
* Remote and flexible. Fully remote collaboration.
* Digital office. Slack, Notion, Miro, and Zoom, with every license you need.

title: Director, Brand Design
description:
**About Us**

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive "sick-care" to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against "we caught it too late again".

Reporting to the VP, Design & Experience, the Director, Creative will lead Prenuvo's Creative function and oversee a multidisciplinary team of contributors. This leadership role is responsible for the Creative function as a whole; its people, capabilities, priorities, creative vision, quality, and effectiveness. The Director, Creative will oversee Prenuvo's creative expression across brand, campaigns, paid media, social, web, content, motion, physical environments, events, partnerships, and emerging experiences.

Your role is both directive and integrative. You'll set the creative vision and quality bar while leading through your team, giving them the clarity, ownership, and autonomy to independently direct programs, disciplines, and bodies of work. You'll partner closely with Marketing, Growth, Product Design, Clinical, Commercial, CX, and other subject-matter experts to ensure creative work is compelling, accurate, and responsive to the needs of a healthcare environment.

You'll combine a strong creative point of view with organizational leadership—building the team and capabilities we need, establishing scalable creative practices, and partnering across the company to turn brand and business strategy into exceptional creative work. This is a fully remote position open to candidates authorized to work in the United States. Occasional travel may be required for team gatherings, productions, events, and other business needs.

**This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).**

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people's lives!

**What You'll Do**

* **Vision & creative direction**
  + Own and evolve Prenuvo's creative expression, translating brand and business strategy into a distinctive experience across channels.
  + Set the creative vision, principles, and quality standards that guide the brand design team and its partners.
  + Provide senior creative direction for major campaigns, launches, partnerships, and brand initiatives while empowering Creative Leads to direct individual programs and bodies of work.
  + Ensure the brand remains cohesive while continuing to evolve as Prenuvo, its audiences, and its offerings grow.
* **Organizational leadership**
  + Own the structure, capabilities, performance, and development of Prenuvo's Creative function, building a multidisciplinary team capable of supporting the company's evolving brand and business needs.
  + Lead and develop team members, establishing clear accountability and empowering them to lead their teams and work independently.
  + Identify capability and talent gaps and determine where to build internally versus leverage agencies, freelancers, and production partners.
  + Create an environment of high standards, collaboration, accountability, creative ambition, and professional growth.
* **Portfolio, priorities, and resources**
  + Own creative portfolio planning and resourcing, partnering with the VP of Design & Experience and cross-functional leaders to prioritize creative investment against the company's highest-value opportunities.
  + Balance business demand, team capacity, strategic importance, and creative opportunity when establishing priorities.
  + Ensure the Creative organization has the right talent, partners, processes, and resources to deliver against company priorities.
  + Provide visibility into creative priorities, capacity, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leadership.
* **Cross-functional leadership**
  + Serving as the senior creative authority to the local brand design and creative team while taking broader direction from the VP, Design and Experience and partnering with leaders across Marketing, Growth, Product, Clinical, Commercial, CX, and other functions.
  + Translate business objectives, audience insights, and channel strategies into creative opportunities and direction.
  + Present and advocate for creative strategy and work with senior and executive stakeholders.
  + Partner closely with Product Design where brand and product experiences intersect, creating continuity while maintaining clear ownership between the two functions.
* **Creative systems and effectiveness**
* + Establish scalable approaches to creative intake, prioritization, briefing, review, production, and delivery.
  + Oversee agencies, freelancers, production partners, and other external creative resources.
  + Partner with Marketing and Growth to understand creative performance and translate learnings into stronger creative strategy.
  + Balance brand-building and performance objectives, ensuring short-term optimization doesn't come at the expense of long-term brand equity.
  + Identify opportunities for AI and emerging technologies to improve creative exploration, production, scalability, and efficiency.
  + Remain connected to the work and step directly into creative development when the scale, complexity, or strategic importance of an initiative warrants it.

**What You'll Bring**

* 15+ years of experience in creative, brand, design, or related disciplines, including significant creative leadership experience.
* 5+ years managing and developing creative teams and senior creative talent, with demonstrated success building high-performing multidisciplinary organizations.
* An exceptional portfolio demonstrating brand thinking and creative direction across multiple channels and experiences.
* Deep experience across brand, digital, web, paid advertising, social, video/motion, and integrated campaigns.
* Experience with physical or experiential design—including retail, clinics, hospitality, or events—is highly valued.
* Strong understanding of both brand building and performance marketing.
* Demonstrated experience with portfolio prioritization, resource planning, team building, and organizational development.
* Experience managing agencies, production partners, freelancers, budgets, and complex creative programs.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and articulate the thinking behind creative decisions.
* Familiarity with product and UX design and the ability to partner effectively with Product Design leadership.
* Strong understanding of contemporary creative tools and emerging AI-enabled creative technologies.
* Consumer marketing experience in healthcare, HealthTech, MedTech, wellness, or another regulated industry is strongly preferred.

**Our Values**

First: we are **Pioneers**

* Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are **Platform-Builders**

* We're always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what's ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are **Patients**

* We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients' lives, and we won't stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

**What We Offer**

* An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
* We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
* Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we're doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
* Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
* Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
* Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.
* We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
* **The base salary for this role ranges from $180,000-$210,000 in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location**

*We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

*As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.*

**Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain [****prenuvo.com****]. If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. If you receive communication that you believe to be fraudulent, please report it immediately to jobs@prenuvo.com.**

title: Head of Social & Content
description:
Capital.com is looking for a **Head of Social & Content** to lead the organic storytelling engine for one of the fastest-growing trading and investing platforms in the world. Bringing social and content strategy under one leader, you’ll shape what we say and where we say it across 40+ markets, from platform-native social to a full-funnel content engine that drives traffic, leads and first-time deposits. Reporting to the Brand Director, you’ll lead a team of social media managers, video creators, copywriters, editors and content project managers, and connect organic output to commercial performance. You’ll also work alongside PR and market commentary to keep messaging aligned across the brand.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Own the organic content and social strategy across the full funnel — awareness, consideration, activation, and retention — across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, the owned blog, and educational platforms, defining what we say, where we say it, and how it performs.
* Lead and develop a combined team of social media managers, video creators/editors, copywriters, editors, and content project managers, setting briefs, reviewing output quality, and raising the creative and commercial bar across all formats and regions.
* Set the content agenda across written, static, and short- and long-form video, reviewing scripts and creative concepts before they go into production to ensure ideas are strong, on-brand, and platform-appropriate.
* Build and own the educational and SEO content programme — evergreen video, written, and interactive content that drives organic performance, supports new-user onboarding, and positions Capital.com as a trusted voice in financial markets.
* Act as brand guardian for social and content output: define and enforce tone of voice within this function, document processes so ways of working are clear and accessible, and create training materials that embed consistent standards across regional teams globally.
* Own social and content performance reporting — interrogate channel and campaign analytics, and use social listening tools to track brand sentiment and industry conversation, feeding insights back into strategy.
* Partner with Compliance to ensure all content and social output meets financial promotions standards across Capital.com's jurisdictions, building that awareness into the team's workflow rather than bolting it on at the end.
* Collaborate with CRM and Product on lifecycle content and user journeys to ensure organic strategy supports the wider client experience.
* Partner with the Paid Social team on where organic and paid intersect — agreeing an initial paid push behind a new channel launch (a LinkedIn channel, say), or an organic boosting strategy for high-performing content — so paid and organic reinforce each other rather than running as separate tracks.
* Work closely with our team of market analysts on market commentary and thought-leadership content — this role partners with that team rather than managing it directly.
* Partner with PR, who sit outside this function and own external media relations, to keep organic, social, and earned messaging consistent wherever the brand shows up.
* Own the brand's approach to community engagement across social platforms, and manage relationships with regional marketing teams to ensure global content and social frameworks are understood and applied locally without losing consistency.
* Stay on top of market events, platform trends, and cultural moments, knowing when to move quickly to turn them into content opportunities.

### **Requirements:**

* Proven experience leading a social media and/or content function at a financial services, fintech, or similarly regulated brand, with a track record of building channels and content programmes — not just running them.
* Experience managing and developing teams across multiple disciplines (social, copy, editorial, video, project management), with the ability to give clear direction, honest feedback, and raise output quality.
* Strong working knowledge of financial markets and the regulatory environment that shapes what a brand like Capital.com can and can't say, including financial promotions fluency (fair, clear, and not misleading).
* Strong SEO expertise — content architecture, keyword strategy, and the ability to build evergreen programmes that compound over time — paired with a genuine feel for content: you know why something works on LinkedIn and not on Instagram, and can articulate that to a team of creators.
* Comfort with data: familiarity with platform-native analytics, social listening, and tools such as Sprout Social or Google Analytics, used to shape strategy rather than just report numbers upward.
* Excellent written communication — you can write, edit, and improve copy yourself, and give meaningful creative feedback across written, static, and video content.
* Experience working across multiple markets and languages, adapting global strategies for regional audiences without losing brand coherence.
* Strong organisational skills: this role spans multiple markets, teams, and production pipelines, and you'll need to hold it together without losing attention to detail.
* Comfortable working alongside a Paid Social / Performance team, with a good instinct for when organic content is worth backing with paid spend and how to structure that conversation.

### **Nice to have:**

* Experience at a CFD broker, spread betting provider, or multi-asset trading platform.
* Experience building or managing educational content programmes — courses, video series, explainer content — for retail financial audiences.
* Knowledge of CySEC, ASIC, and other multi-jurisdictional regulatory frameworks for financial promotions.
* Experience briefing and working with external creative or content agencies.
* Experience developing thought leadership content for senior stakeholders.

### **What you will get in return:**

* Competitive Salary: We believe great work deserves great pay! Your skills and talents will be rewarded with a salary that makes you feel valued and motivated.
* Work-Life Harmony: Join a company that genuinely cares about *you*—because your life outside of work matters just as much as your time on the clock.
* Annual Performance Bonus: Your hard work doesn’t go unnoticed! Celebrate your achievements with a well-deserved annual bonus tied to your performance.
* Generous Time Off: Need a breather? Our annual leave policy lets you recharge and enjoy life outside of work without a worry.
* Employee Referral Program: Love working here? Share the love! Bring your talented friends on board and get rewarded for growing our awesome team.
* Comprehensive Health & Pension Benefits: From medical insurance to pension plans, we’ve got your back. Plus, location-specific benefits and perks!
* Workation Wonderland: Live your digital nomad dreams with 30 extra days to work remotely from anywhere in the world (some restrictions apply). Adventure awaits!
* Volunteer Days: Make a difference! Take two additional paid days each year to support causes you care about and give back to the community

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Head of Performance Creative
description:
**Role Objective**
**AtlasBrands is looking for a Head of Performance Creative (Meta) to serve as the "CEO" of our primary acquisition channel.**
Because Meta represents 100% of our customer growth, you will take complete, end-to-end ownership of the channel and leading with an obsessive, direct-response creative strategy while cross-functionally overseeing media buying execution.
  
  
You are a world-class performance creative lead who stays deeply in the trenches, studying market trends and competitor ads to craft high-converting hooks and concepts. Your core objective is to build and scale a pod-based creative department that powers rapid revenue expansion while maintaining strict unit economics, total account stability, and proactive resolution of ad rejections and account risk across high-risk verticals (e.g., supplements). Operating as a strategic player-coach, you will transition current lead oversight, build custom tracking dashboards, and recruit an A-player team that executes with speed and autonomy.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Channel Onboarding & Transition: Audit active ad accounts, creative pipelines, and team members to deliver a clear execution plan. Fully assume Meta decision-making (budgets, launches, creative) and seamlessly transition the incumbent lead into a dedicated Creative Strategist role.
* Brand Scaling Systems: Execute staged growth targets for existing brands at first-rebill break-even or better. Establish a standardized launch protocol for new brands to reach scale rapidly while maintaining a near-perfect success rate.
* Retention & Margin Optimization: Shift brands from first-rebill break-even to first-purchase break-even as they mature, sustaining performance month-over-month. Proactively flag risks ahead of time with actionable recovery plans.
* Ad Rejection & Account Health Management: Rapidly troubleshoot and resolve ad rejections, policy flags, and disablements inherent to high-risk verticals (e.g., supplements). Set up and manage redundant account architecture (backup BMs, ad accounts, payment methods) to guarantee zero downtime and keep spend scaling uninterrupted.
* Pod Architecture & Department Building: Grade current team members and design final pod structures. Fully staff every pod with top-tier talent so strategists own creative direction end-to-end.
* Analytics & AI Operations: Build custom AI-driven live dashboards (using Claude) tracking spend, acquisition costs, payback periods, creative win rates, and rejection rates. Lead concise weekly executive syncs that require zero prep from leadership.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Proven $100K+/Day Scale: Track record taking DTC brands to aggressive scale, directly responsible for managing $100K+ daily Meta ad spend across catalog depth (6–10+ distinct SKUs).
* Direct-Response Mastery & In-the-Trenches Mindset: Obsessed with studying winning market trends, analyzing competitor ads, and turning consumer psychology into high-velocity creative concepts.
* Operational Resilience in High-Risk Verticals: Hands-on experience resolving policy flags, ad rejections, and account risks in supplement/health categories while keeping spend live via backup account infrastructure.
* High-Tempo Work Ethic (60+ Hrs/Wk): Hyper-ambitious operator who thrives under high pressure, brings a history of 60+ hour work weeks, and wants to grind alongside an elite team pushing toward 9 figures.
* Full Channel Ownership & Execution: Operates as a true "CEO of Meta"—building A-player creative pods, overseeing media buying alignment, and executing with extreme speed and autonomy.
* AI-Driven Automation: Leverages modern LLMs (Claude, GPTs) and automated data workflows to streamline creative analysis, build tracking dashboards, and scale output.

**Working Hours & Culture**

* Role Timeline: Full-time leadership hire.
* Async-First: Global, remote-first team setup requiring core daily overlap with US EST business hours for team syncs and cross-functional alignment.

**How To Apply & What To Expect**
At AtlasBrands, we value your time and expertise, which is why we’ve built a streamlined, highly transparent interview process designed to look for a true partner rather than a transactional contributor.

* Finding new winning angles and audiences

title: Creative Project Manager
description:

* Mentor, strengthen, and develop creatives remotely across the Middle East through effective performance management.

* Brainstorming new shoot ideas with support from the insights and curation team.

* Must be able to secure a passport and travel internationally on an occasional basis.

### **Nice to Have:**

* Professional proficiency in Arabic is a plus, though candidates are not required to speak Arabic to be considered.

There’s a story in every picture, a narrative in every frame.

We believe in the power of visuals. As a leading visual content creator, our three brands–Getty Images, iStock, and Unsplash–offer a full range of content solutions to meet the needs of any customer, whatever their size, location, or budget. Whether the goal is commercial or philanthropic, revenue-generating or society-changing, market-disrupting or headline-driving, our visuals help any brand, business, or organization communicate more effectively with their target audience and urge them to action. In other words, we know how powerful an image or video can be—and that it can move the world.

Working at Getty Images

Our goal is to be one of the best places to work globally, which means we’re dedicated to providing experiences and resources that allow you to do your best work. Foundational to our culture are our Leadership Principles, which are the shared values that guide how we come together to do our work. We raise the bar and collectively bring solutions while exercising trust, transparency, and care. We actively reject biased behavior and are inclusive of different voices, perspectives, and experiences. We focus on our customers and deliver on our commitments and commercial goals.

We foster a collaborative and supportive environment that prioritizes delivering results efficiently and using time wisely, so that all employees can achieve balance between commitments to the company and health and well-being in our lives. We value the importance of rest and recovery ranging from company-paid holidays to time away from work.

Our employees’ growth, development, belonging, and engagement are important investments. We offer learning experiences ranging from leadership development, diversity and inclusion training, mentoring programs, a high potential program, and professional and skills development. We prioritize staying connected in our hybrid-working world and encourage participation in global morale events and local gatherings, as well as finding community in one or more of our Employee Resource Groups. title: Senior Creative Manager
description:

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.
  
  
Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.
  
  
Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

**What You'll Be Doing**
As a Senior Creative Manager, you will lead the development and execution of a 360° brand and creative strategy, shaping compelling concepts and delivering impactful campaigns across multiple customer touchpoints.
  
  
You will play a key role in strengthening brand identity, driving creative innovation and ensuring a consistent omnichannel experience. Combining strategic vision with hands-on execution, you will lead a team of creative professionals, bringing bold ideas to life while ensuring creative excellence across all channels.
  
  
**Creative Strategy & Brand Development**

* Develop and execute an integrated 360° creative strategy aligned with the brand's identity, positioning and business objectives.
* Act as a guardian of brand identity, ensuring consistency in creative direction, visual language, storytelling and tone of voice.
* Conceptualize and deliver innovative campaigns that strengthen brand equity, customer engagement and conversion.
* Translate brand strategy into compelling creative concepts, adapting content and messaging across different markets and channels.
* Stay ahead of emerging creative trends, bringing fresh perspectives and innovative ideas to brand communication.

**Omnichannel Campaigns & Creative Execution**

* Lead the development and execution of integrated campaigns across digital, e-commerce, CRM, visual merchandising and physical customer touchpoints.
* Ensure creative concepts are adapted effectively to each channel while maintaining a consistent brand experience and cohesive storytelling.
* Oversee creative assets across design, video, production, packaging, visual merchandising and digital experiences.
* Develop production briefs, manage creative shoots and collaborate with external production partners to deliver high-quality outputs.
* Partner with marketing, customer experience and commercial teams to align creative initiatives with business priorities.

**Creative Leadership & Project Management**

* Lead, coach and develop a team of creative professionals, fostering collaboration, innovation and accountability.
* Oversee creative workflows, project timelines, workload allocation and resource planning to ensure timely delivery.
* Balance strategic creative development with hands-on execution across multiple projects and campaigns.
* Drive creative excellence while establishing an efficient, collaborative and solutions-oriented working environment.

**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
Proven experience in developing and executing brand and creative strategies, including integrated 360° campaigns.
  
  

* A minimum of 4 years of managerial experience, with demonstrated ability to lead, motivate and develop creative teams.
* Strong omnichannel experience, with an understanding of how creative concepts translate across physical and digital customer touchpoints.
* Experience across multiple creative disciplines, including design, video, production, packaging, visual merchandising and UX.
* Strong conceptual thinking, storytelling and brand-building capabilities, with the ability to translate ideas into impactful creative outputs.
* Experience managing creative production, external agencies and multiple projects simultaneously.

* Familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and their application in enhancing creative output and efficiency.

**Show Us Your Work**

We are particularly interested in understanding your creative contribution, the channels involved and how your ideas translated into execution.

We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.

title: Director of Design Execution
description:
### **About Switch**

At Switch, we don't just design, build and operate data centers—we are enabling the technology of the future. Led by Founder & CEO, Rob Roy, we believe in revolutionary innovation, operational excellence and the principle of karma. Switch is where talented people come together to EVOLVE the digital world.

We believe that innovation isn't just about technology—it's about the people, culture, and purpose that make it happen. Every Switch team member contributes to a mission greater than themselves: to create the world's most advanced digital infrastructure that powers the progress of humanity.

**The Role: Director of Design Execution**
------------------------------------------

The Director of Design Execution provides enterprise leadership for the practical execution, technical coordination, and field validation of data center designs across Switch's project portfolio. This role leads the team responsible for translating design intent into solutions that are safe, constructible, commissionable, operable, maintainable, and repeatable.

You will lead Design Execution from post-design handoff through construction, commissioning, turnover, and operational readiness while providing technical support throughout the infrastructure lifecycle. You will establish engineering governance, execution standards, decision and escalation processes, and feedback mechanisms that improve reliability and consistency across regions.

This role leads a team of technical subject matter experts and manages supporting third-party consultants and contractors. You will also partner closely with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Operations, EHS, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to improve project delivery and turn field experience into standards and lessons learned for future projects.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Lead and develop the Design Execution team, including technical subject matter experts and supporting third-party consultants and contractors.
* Set team priorities, allocate resources, establish performance expectations, and provide coaching and development.
* Lead Design Execution activities across the project lifecycle, including design handoff, construction, commissioning, turnover, operations support, infrastructure improvements, and end-of-life planning.
* Establish and maintain the engineering governance framework for post-IFC execution, including handoff requirements, engineering decision management, escalation pathways, design-change oversight, performance metrics, and continuous improvement.
* Translate design intent into practical field execution requirements that support constructability, commissioning, maintainability, and operational readiness.
* Oversee resolution of construction and field engineering issues, including complex procedure reviews, critical equipment concerns, and technical event support.
* Oversee engineering solutions for upgrades and retrofits that increase capacity, availability, efficiency, reliability, or operational capability across existing data centers.
* Provide technical leadership for electrical and mechanical infrastructure, including transformers, generators, UPS systems, power distribution, HVAC and cooling systems, controls, and related critical infrastructure.
* Review and interpret construction drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, sequences of operation, specifications, submittals, and other engineering documentation.
* Partner with Design Engineering to translate field experience, operational feedback, commissioning results, and lessons learned into improved standards and future designs.
* Coordinate with Construction, Commissioning, Operations, EHS, and other stakeholders to maintain consistent technical and execution standards across projects.
* Manage engineering consultants, vendors, contractors, and other external technical resources supporting Design Execution.
* Establish processes, procedures, and tools that enable consistent execution and support customer and project requirements across data center campuses.
* Establish and monitor Design Execution performance metrics and provide project, risk, and program updates to senior leadership.
* Lead assigned engineering projects and programs and ensure delivery against schedule, budget, quality, and operational requirements.
* Coordinate maintenance windows and implementation activities with facility leadership to minimize operational disruption.
* Ensure Design Execution activities comply with applicable codes, regulations, Switch requirements, and safety standards, including NFPA 70E requirements where applicable.
* Support Operations during turnover, customer-impacting events, near misses, and other complex technical situations.
* Identify systemic issues, recurring field challenges, and opportunities to improve execution, reliability, efficiency, and cost.
* Build strong working relationships across Operations, Finance, Legal, Construction, Commissioning, Design Engineering, and other stakeholders.
* Maintain an active field presence to understand conditions firsthand and validate that solutions can be executed as intended.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* You lead technical teams with clear expectations, accountability, coaching, and consistent follow-through.
* You make sound engineering decisions while balancing safety, reliability, constructability, cost, schedule, and operational impact.
* You can make informed recommendations when technical information is incomplete or conditions are changing.
* You identify design and execution risks early and develop practical solutions before they affect project or operational outcomes.
* You communicate complex engineering issues clearly to technical teams, business partners, and senior leadership.
* You build alignment across Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Operations, and external partners.
* You establish standards and governance that improve consistency without creating unnecessary barriers to execution.
* You use field experience, data, root cause analysis, and lessons learned to drive continuous improvement.
* You develop internal talent while holding consultants, contractors, and other external resources accountable for quality and results.
* You are comfortable spending time in the field to understand problems firsthand and validate solutions.
* You demonstrate the judgment, accountability, collaboration, and leadership expected under Switch's Culture Codes.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive engineering experience supporting industrial, commercial, or mission-critical facilities such as data centers, power generation, or oil and gas facilities.
* 5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, technical professionals, consultants, or comparable resources.
* 4+ years of project management experience supporting data center engineering or comparable mission-critical infrastructure.
* Deep understanding of electrical and mechanical systems used in mission-critical environments, including power distribution, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, cooling systems, HVAC, controls, and fire protection.
* Experience leading or supporting construction, commissioning, turnover, operational readiness, retrofit, or infrastructure improvement activities.
* Experience managing engineering projects, consultants, contractors, and other external technical resources.
* Experience reading, interpreting, and reviewing construction drawings, specifications, submittals, wiring diagrams, schematics, sequences of operation, and MEP documentation.
* Experience with EPMS, SCADA, BMS, or comparable monitoring and controls systems.
* Strong knowledge of safety requirements and applicable OSHA standards for multi-megawatt or mission-critical facilities.
* Working knowledge of NFPA 70E and electrical safety requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute solutions for complex engineering and operational problems.
* Strong project and program management, prioritization, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Experience using engineering, project management, calculation, data analysis, and collaboration tools.
* Ability to support after-hours or weekend activities when required for critical projects, maintenance windows, commissioning, or operational events.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally as business needs require.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
* Professional Engineer registration or other relevant professional engineering certification.
* Experience leading enterprise or multi-region engineering programs within data centers or other mission-critical environments.
* Experience establishing engineering governance, technical standards, design-change processes, or post-IFC execution frameworks.
* Experience supporting root cause analysis, fleet optimization, lifecycle management, and infrastructure reliability programs.

We recognize that qualified candidates may not meet every preferred qualification. If your experience aligns with the core responsibilities of the role, we encourage you to apply.

### **Why Switch?**

* A Culture of Karma – We are self-motivated by karma, ensuring our actions contribute to a positive, supportive and forward-thinking environment.
* Industry Leading Designs – Work with the most advanced data center technology on the planet and be a part of emerging technology development.

* Career Stability & Growth – In this expanding industry, we invest in our people, providing opportunities & advancement in a stable, growing company.

Apply Now and Let's Build the Future Together.

title: Senior Director, Product Creative Direction
description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**Team and Role**

This role is part of our Product Design team, which turns a deep understanding of our users and customers into product experiences they love. Our designers bring expertise across design systems, visual design, interaction design, content design, and product design. At ServiceNow, design has an intentional seat at the table, and we partner with Engineering and Product Management from the outset.

We're looking for a Senior Director of Product Creative Direction to define and evolve the visual expression of our product portfolio. This leader will set a distinctive product visual direction, translate it into a scalable system, and help teams make complex enterprise software feel clear, coherent, modern, and unmistakably ServiceNow.

This is a product-focused creative leadership role. You will work as part of cross-functional software development teams and partner across Platform and the business units to connect creative vision with customer needs, product strategy, and technical realities. Product teams retain ownership of their product strategy, design, roadmap, quality, and delivery; this role provides shared visual direction, systems, critique, and enablement.

You will also advance the responsible use of AI in creative work and make accessibility intrinsic to the product visual language.

**What you get to do in this role**

* Define and champion a differentiated visual direction for the product portfolio, grounded in our brand, customer needs, product strategy, and the evolving relationship between people and AI.
* Establish a clear point of view across typography, color, composition, iconography, illustration, motion, data visualization, density, and other visual foundations.
* Create future-state concepts, reference experiences, and exemplars that make the visual direction tangible.
* Work with Design Systems, Product Design, Content Design, Accessibility, Localization, and Research to translate the visual language into scalable foundations, components, patterns, and guidance.
* Partner with Design Systems, Product Management and Engineering throughout the software development lifecycle so the creative direction can be applied effectively in shipped products.
* Define where consistency is essential, where variation creates value, and how teams can extend the system without creating a centralized bottleneck.
* Lead the strategy for AI-enabled creative exploration, prototyping, asset creation, system evolution, and evaluation, focusing on meaningful gains in range, speed, consistency, and quality.
* Move promising AI approaches from experimentation to repeatable practice through pilots, playbooks, training, exemplars, responsible-use standards, and measurable adoption goals.
* Provide creative direction and hands-on critique for priority, cross-product initiatives while reinforcing product-team ownership.
* Partner with Brand and Marketing so the company expression and product experience tell a coherent story while remaining useful and native to interactive software.
* Make accessibility intrinsic to the creative vision and visual foundations, partnering with Accessibility and Engineering to meet or exceed applicable standards, including WCAG 2.2 AA.
* Lead, develop, and attract exceptional visual, motion, and multidisciplinary design talent.
* Build the culture, enablement, and shared critique practices that help product designers and distributed visual designers understand, apply, and continually raise the visual craft bar.
* Build a network of creative leaders and contributors across the business units who can extend the direction while maintaining coherence.

 **Qualifications**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in product design, visual design, experience design, creative direction, or a related field, including significant leadership experience shipping complex digital products.
* A portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft and creative leadership across shipped product experiences, not only brand campaigns or marketing communications.
* Experience defining or materially evolving a visual language across a complex, multi-product software portfolio.
* Deep understanding of design systems, including visual foundations, design tokens, components, patterns, governance, contribution models, and the relationship between design and code.
* Demonstrated experience adopting AI-enabled creative tools and workflows and moving teams from isolated experimentation to sustained, responsible use at scale.
* Proven ability to influence senior executives and align multiple organizations without relying solely on reporting authority.
* Expert command of typography, color, composition, interaction, motion, and information hierarchy, with the judgment to apply them to dense and complex product workflows.
* Strong systems thinking and the ability to connect an inspiring creative idea to the practices and adoption mechanisms required to make it real at scale.
* Demonstrated commitment to accessible and inclusive design, with working knowledge of WCAG and platform accessibility considerations.
* Excellent communication, storytelling, facilitation, and critique skills, including the ability to make a direction compelling to executives and actionable for delivery teams.
* Experience leading leaders and building high-performing, inclusive creative teams.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience participating in the complete product development lifecycle of web and/or software applications.
* Experience working as a member of cross-functional Product Management, Engineering, and Design teams.
* Experience leading creative teams and partnering across a complex organization.

title: Director of Brand and Creative
description:
Proof is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started!

Proof's brand has to signal two things at once: the rigor of a WebTrust-audited certificate authority that banks can rely on, and the simplicity of an identity people can verify once and reuse anywhere. As Proof expands from the online notarization category we created into portable digital identity and agentic authorization, our brand needs to grow with us.

As Director of Brand and Creative, you'll own Proof's brand strategy, visual and verbal identity, and creative output across every touchpoint, including proof.com, campaigns, events, sales materials, and executive presence. Day to day, you'll set creative direction, lead design production, and build a brand that earns trust from regulated institutions and stands out in identity and fintech.

### **What you’ll do as the Director of Brand and Creative at Proof:**

* Brand strategy and architecture: Define and steward Proof's brand platform (purpose, personality, voice, and the promise of trust in high-consequence transactions), and develop brand architecture for the platform, VDC, notarization, and agentic authorization with the Director of Product Marketing. Lead brand evolution or refresh work as needed.
* Visual and verbal identity: Own the brand system and guidelines, including logo, color, typography, iconography, illustration, photography, motion, and data visualization. Partner with the Head of Demand Content and Director of Communications on tone-of-voice guidelines.
* Brand hub and templates: Build a self-serve brand hub and template library so Sales,  
  Marketing, and the wider company stay on brand.
* Campaign and launch creative: Lead creative concepting and execution for  
  campaigns, product launches, and brand moments with Revenue Marketing and Product Marketing.
* Design across touchpoints: Oversee design for proof.com, digital advertising, sales collateral, presentations, video, social, and event environments, including booth and experiential design with the Event Marketing Manager.
* Creative operations: Run intake, prioritization, and review and approval workflows, and manage creative budgets, agencies, and freelancers.
* Brand health and governance: Establish brand health metrics and research  
  (awareness, consideration, perception among target buyers), govern consistency across marketing, sales, partners, and co-marketing, and work with Product Design so the product and marketing brand feel like one company.

### **What we're looking for:**

* 10+ years in brand and creative, including 4+ years leading brand or creative teams at a B2B technology, fintech, or security company, or senior agency experience on comparable brands.
* A portfolio showing brand systems and campaigns that made complex or trust-centric products clear and distinctive.
* Experience leading a brand refresh or new brand architecture during a company's category expansion.
* Strong creative direction across design, copy, video, and motion, and the ability to get hands-on when needed.
* Ability to align executives on creative decisions and explain the business rationale behind brand choices.

### **You'll really stand out if you have:**

* Experience building brands for financial services, payments, or identity companies.
* Experience with AI-assisted creative workflows and modern tooling (Figma, Adobe CC, Webflow).
* Experience spanning both B2B enterprise and consumer-facing touchpoints.

### **Position Logistics:**

**Travel:** This role will include occasional travel for Proof Summit, team onsites, industry events, and customer or partner meetings. Your manager will share more about expected travel during the interview process.

### **Our Proof Pillars:**

title: Director of Product Design, Engage
description:
**About Ancestry:**

When you join Ancestry, you join a human-centered company where every person’s story is important. Ancestry®, the global leader in family history, connects everyone with their past so they can discover, preserve, and share their unique family stories. With our unparalleled collection of more than 65 billion records, over 3.5 million subscribers, and over 27 million people in our growing DNA network, customers can discover their family story and gain a new level of understanding about their lives. Over the past 40 years, we’ve built trusted relationships with millions of people who have chosen us as the platform for discovering, preserving, and sharing the most important information about themselves and their families.
  
  
We are committed to our location flexible work approach, allowing you to choose to work in the nearest office, from your home, or a hybrid of both (subject to location restrictions and roles that are required to be in the office- ). We will continue to hire and promote beyond the boundaries of our office locations, to enable broadened possibilities for employee diversity.
  
  
Together, we work every day to foster a work environment that's inclusive as well as diverse, and where our people can be themselves. Every idea and perspective is valued so that our products and services reflect the global and diverse clients we serve.
  
  
Ancestry encourages applications from minorities, women, the disabled, protected veterans and all other qualified applicants. Passionate about dedicating your work to enriching people’s lives? Join the curious.

This role is a rare opportunity to lead design for the heart of Ancestry’s product—the Tree, the Person Page, Merge, and Records—foundational experiences that define how millions of users engage with their family history. As Director of Product Design on the Engage team, you’ll be at the center of our most critical product surfaces, ensuring they work seamlessly together to deliver clarity, connection, and discovery. This is not just about optimizing what already exists; it’s about reimagining how these core experiences evolve as a unified ecosystem. It requires a design leader with a strong product sensibility, a systems-thinking mindset, and the ability to balance craft with scale. You’ll need to advocate across disciplines, align with senior stakeholders, and guide a team through complexity and legacy to deliver elegant, human-centered solutions. For someone who wants to shape the future of our flagship experience—and the legacy of the Ancestry brand—this is that moment.

  

**What you’ll do**

* Lead the design vision and execution for the Engage team, ensuring cohesion and delight across the full customer journey.
* Partner across product areas and functions to eliminate friction, fill gaps, and ensure customers experience Ancestry as a rich, connected, and purpose-driven platform.
* Identify and prioritize key moments in the user journey that drive trust, retention, and discovery — and improve them through thoughtful product design and iteration.
* Collaborate closely with product, engineering, data, marketing, and customer support to ensure every touchpoint is aligned and intentional.
* Translate insights from qualitative research and quantitative data into actionable design direction, balancing creativity and clarity.
* Evangelize the customer journey internally — bringing a user-first lens to cross-org decision making and fostering a culture of customer empathy.
* Guide the creation of key design artifacts, including user flows, prototypes, wireframes, and visual systems.
* Coach and mentor a team of talented designers, helping them collaborate and grow as strategic thinkers and empathic customer advocates.

**Who you are**

* Extensive experience in UX or product design, including a track record of leading design in cross-functional, collaborative environments.
* Proven ability to move between strategic thinking and hands-on execution with ease.
* Deep understanding of end-to-end customer journey mapping and experience design.
* Experience leading teams focused on onboarding, lifecycle, navigation, and engagement.
* A strong foundation in human-centered design, with the ability to bring clarity to complex or unfamiliar spaces.
* Strong communicator and influencer who can align diverse stakeholders around a shared vision.
* Passionate about creating connected, high-trust experiences that put the user first.
* *Bonus: Background in consumer subscription products, digital ecosystems, or identity-driven experiences.*

  

**Why Ancestry?**

Join a dedicated team working to connect millions of people with their past and enrich their futures. At Ancestry, you will play a role in pioneering legal solutions that shape the consumer genomics industry. Your contributions will help foster and protect our workforce that is dedicated to helping our customers tell their own stories, while supporting a brand recognized and trusted around the world. We offer a collaborative workplace, competitive compensation, and the opportunity to make a meaningful difference.

  

**Compensation**

Ancestry values pay transparency and equity. As a signatory of the ParityPledge in Support of Women and the ParityPledge in Support of People of Color, we are pleased to share the base salary range for this position: $195,000 - $208,000, with eligibility for bonus, equity, and comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision. Actual salary will depend on location and experience. We will provide detailed compensation data for a specific location during the recruiting process.
